title.zh: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一
title.raw: 卷三十三 本紀第三十三 孝宗一 Volume 33 Annals 33: Xiaozong 1

sentences.zh: 及元懿太子薨，高宗未有後，而昭慈聖獻皇后亦自江西還行在，後嘗感異夢，密爲高宗言之，高宗大寤。

translations.literal: When Prince Yuanyi died, Gaozong had no heir, and Empress Dowager Zhaoci Shengxian also returned from Jiangxi to the temporary capital. The empress had once been moved by a strange dream and told Gaozong of it in secret; Gaozong was greatly awakened.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Yuanyi's death, Emperor Gaozong still had no successor, and Empress Dowager Meng had also come back from Jiangxi to the court at Lin'an. She had had a portentous dream and confided it to Gaozong in private; the emperor was deeply stirred.

sentences.zh: 會右僕射范宗尹亦造膝以請，高宗曰：「太祖以神武定天下，子孫不得享之，遭時多艱，零落可憫。

translations.literal: At that time the Right Vice Director Fan Zongyin also came forward to plead at close audience. Gaozong said: "Taizu by divine martial prowess settled the realm, yet his descendants could not enjoy it—meeting times of many hardships, their dispersion is pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: Right at that moment Vice Director Fan Zongyin pressed the matter in audience. Gaozong said, "Our Founder subdued the empire by martial genius, yet his line could not hold it; battered by hard times, their fall is heartbreaking.

sentences.zh: 朕若不法仁宗，爲天下計，何以慰在天之靈！

translations.literal: If I do not follow Emperor Renzong's example and act for the sake of the realm, how can I comfort the spirit in Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: If I do not take Renzong as my model and choose for the good of the empire, how shall I answer those above?

sentences.zh: 」於是詔選太祖之後。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict was issued to select a descendant of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: " He then ordered that an heir be chosen from Taizu's line.

sentences.zh: 同知樞密院事李回曰：「藝祖不以大位私其子，發于至誠。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Hui said: "The Founding Emperor did not reserve the great position for his own son; it sprang from utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, deputy head of the Bureau of Military Affairs, said, "Taizu refused to keep the throne for his son—that came from perfect sincerity.

sentences.zh: 陛下爲天下遠慮，合于藝祖，可以昭格天命。

translations.literal: Your Majesty plans far ahead for the realm; this accords with the Founding Emperor and can make clear that you answer Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's far-sighted choice for the realm matches Taizu's act and will show Heaven that the mandate is honored.

sentences.zh: 」參知政事張守曰：「藝祖諸子，不聞失德，而傳位太宗，過堯、舜遠甚。

translations.literal: " Participating Administrator Zhang Shou said: "The Founding Emperor's sons were never heard to lack virtue, yet he passed the throne to Emperor Taizong—surpassing Yao and Shun by far.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Shou, a participating administrator, said, "None of Taizu's sons was known for vice, yet he gave the throne to Taizong—a deed that puts even Yao and Shun in the shade.

sentences.zh: 」高宗曰：「此事不難行，朕于'伯'字行中選擇，庶幾昭穆順序。

translations.literal: " Gaozong said: "This matter is not hard to carry out; I shall choose from the generation of the character 'bo' so that the zhao-mu order may be preserved.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozong replied, "That is easily done. I will pick from the 'bo' generation so the ancestral ranks stay in order.

sentences.zh: 」而上虞丞婁寅亮亦上書言：「昌陵之後，寂寥無聞，僅同民庶。

translations.literal: " Meanwhile Assistant Magistrate of Shangyu Lou Yinliang also submitted a memorial saying: "After Changling, the line has been silent and unknown, no more than commoners.
translations.idiomatic: " Lou Yinliang, assistant magistrate of Shangyu, wrote in, "Since Changling the imperial branch has dwindled to obscurity, scarcely above the people.

sentences.zh: 藝祖在上，莫肯顧歆，此金人所以未悔禍也。

translations.literal: Taizu above will not look down with favor; this is why the Jurchens have not yet repented of their calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu in heaven will not look kindly on us; that is why the Jin have not yet turned from their violence.

sentences.zh: 望陛下于'伯'字行內選太祖諸孫有賢德者。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will select from among Taizu's grandsons in the 'bo' generation one who has worth and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Choose, sire, a worthy grandson of Taizu from the 'bo' generation.

sentences.zh: 」高宗讀之，大感歎。

translations.literal: " Gaozong read it and was deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozong read the memorial and was deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 紹興二年五月，選帝育於禁中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Shaoxing, the emperor was chosen and raised in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Shaoxing 2 (1132), the boy was taken into the palace to be reared.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，除和州防御使，賜名瑗。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he was appointed Defender of Hezhou and given the name Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 3 he was made Defender of Hezhou and named Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改貴州。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, he was transferred to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day his post was changed to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 五年五月，用左僕射趙鼎議，立書院宮中教之，既成，遂以爲資善堂。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year, following the proposal of Left Vice Director Zhao Ding, a academy was established in the palace to teach him; when it was completed, it was named the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 5, on Zhao Ding's advice, a school was set up inside the palace; when finished it was called the Hall of Cultivating Goodness.

sentences.zh: 帝讀書強記，天資特異。

translations.literal: The emperor read with a strong memory; his natural gifts were exceptional.
translations.idiomatic: He was a prodigious reader with a remarkable memory and unusual talent.

sentences.zh: 己亥，制授保慶軍節度使，封建國公。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, by imperial order he was made Military Commissioner of Baoqing and enfeoffed as Duke of the State.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day he was appointed Military Commissioner of Baoqing and created Duke of the State.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，聽讀資善堂，以徽猷閣待制範沖兼詡善，起居郎朱震兼贊讀，高宗命帝見沖、震皆拜。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the sixth month, he was permitted to attend lectures at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness; Huizhen Pavilion Attendant Fan Chong was made tutor and Recorder Zhu Zhen was made lecturing reader. Gaozong ordered the emperor to bow when he met Chong and Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day in the sixth month he began study at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness, with Fan Chong as tutor and Zhu Zhen as reader. Gaozong commanded that he bow to them on meeting.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月丁酉，加檢校少保，封普安郡王。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, on the day dingyou, he was made Junior Guardian by inspection and enfeoffed as Prince of Pu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12, on dingyou day, he was made Junior Guardian and created Prince of Pu'an.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，出閣就外第。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renyin, he left the palace and took up residence outside.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renyin day, he moved out of the palace to his own residence.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月，秀王歿於秀州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, Prince Xiu died in Xiuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 13, Prince Xiu died at Xiuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月庚辰，用廷臣議，聽解官行服。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year, on the day gengchen, following court discussion, he was permitted to resign office and observe mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 14, on gengchen day, the court allowed him to leave office and mourn.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月乙巳，免喪，還舊官。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the sixteenth year, on the day yisi, mourning ended and he resumed his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 16, on yisi day, mourning ended and he returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月戊午，改常德軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the sixth month of the seventeenth year, he was made Military Commissioner of Changde.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day in the sixth month of year 17 he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Changde.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，衢州盜起，秦檜遣殿前司將官辛立將千人捕之，不以聞。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year bandits rose in Quzhou; Qin Hui sent Palace Front Division officer Xin Li with a thousand men to suppress them and did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 rebels broke out in Quzhou. Qin Hui sent a thousand troops under Xin Li without informing the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝入侍言之，高宗大驚。

translations.literal: When the emperor attended audience he spoke of it, and Gaozong was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: The prince mentioned it while attending Gaozong, who was shocked.

sentences.zh: 明日，以問檜，檜謂不足煩聖慮，故不敢聞，俟朝夕盜平則奏矣。

translations.literal: The next day, when he asked Qin Hui, Qin Hui said it was not worth troubling the sage's concern, so he had not reported it; he would memorialize once the bandits were pacified morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: Next day Gaozong questioned Qin Hui, who said the matter was too slight to trouble the emperor and that he would report once the rebels were crushed.

sentences.zh: 檜退，知爲帝言，忌之。

translations.literal: Qin Hui withdrew, knowing the prince had spoken, and resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Hui left knowing the prince had told, and bore a grudge.

sentences.zh: 及檜疾篤，其家秘不以聞，謀以子熺代相，帝又密啟高宗破其奸。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui grew gravely ill his family kept it secret; they plotted to have his son Qi succeed as chief minister, and the emperor again secretly informed Gaozong and broke their plot.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui fell seriously ill his household hid it and schemed to put his son Qi in power; the prince again warned Gaozong and foiled them.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月癸酉，立爲皇子，更名瑋。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the second month of the thirtieth year he was established as imperial son and renamed Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the second month of year 30 he was made imperial son and renamed Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔下。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙子，制授甯國軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封建王。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi by imperial order he was made Military Commissioner of Ningguo and Grand Master of the Palace with the Honor of the Three Dukes, and advanced to Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he was made Military Commissioner of Ningguo and Grand Master with honors equal to the Three Dukes, and advanced to Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 制出，中外大悅。

translations.literal: When the order was issued, inside and outside the court rejoiced greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Court and country rejoiced when the appointment was announced.

sentences.zh: 四月，賜字元瑰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month he was granted the courtesy name Yuanrui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month he received the courtesy name Yuanrui.

sentences.zh: 三十一年十月壬子，以明堂恩，改鎮南軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the tenth month of the thirty-first year, by the grace of the Bright Hall ceremony, he was made Military Commissioner of Zhennan.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the tenth month of year 31, by Bright Hall grace, he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Zhennan.

sentences.zh: 先是，金人犯邊，高宗下詔親征，而兩淮失守，朝臣多陳退避之計，帝不勝其憤，請率師爲前驅。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Jurchens invaded the border, Gaozong issued an edict for a personal campaign; the two Huai regions fell, and court officials mostly urged retreat—the emperor could not contain his anger and asked to lead the army as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Jin attacked, Gaozong had ordered a personal campaign; after the Huai line collapsed many ministers urged withdrawal. The prince, furious, volunteered to lead the van.

sentences.zh: 直講史浩以疾在告，聞之亟入，爲帝言，太子不宜將兵，乃爲草奏，因中宮以進，請衛從以共子職。

translations.literal: Direct Lecturer Shi Hao was on sick leave; hearing this he hurried in and told the emperor that the heir should not command troops. He drafted a memorial and submitted it through the inner palace, asking to guard the imperial person in fulfillment of a son's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Lecturer Shi Hao, though ill, rushed in and argued that a crown prince must not take the field. He drafted a memorial sent through the inner court, offering instead to guard the emperor as a son should.

sentences.zh: 高宗因亦欲帝遍識諸將，十二月，遂扈蹕如金陵。

translations.literal: Gaozong also wished the emperor to know all the generals; in the twelfth month he accompanied the imperial procession to Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong also wanted him to meet the commanders; in the twelfth month he escorted the court to Jinling.

sentences.zh: 三十二年五月甲子，立爲皇太子，改名昚。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the fifth month of the thirty-second year he was established as crown prince and renamed Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the fifth month of year 32 he was made crown prince and renamed Shen.

sentences.zh: 初，高宗久有禪位之意，嘗以諭帝，帝流涕固辭，會有邊事不果。

translations.literal: Earlier Gaozong had long intended to abdicate and had told the emperor so; the emperor wept and firmly declined, and because of border affairs it did not come to pass.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong had long meant to abdicate and had told him so; the prince wept and refused, and border troubles postponed the plan.

sentences.zh: 及歸自金陵，陳康伯求去，高宗復以倦勤諭之。

translations.literal: When he returned from Jinling, Chen Kangbo asked to retire, and Gaozong again spoke to him of weariness with rule.
translations.idiomatic: After the return from Jinling, Chen Kangbo sought to leave office, and Gaozong again spoke of abdication.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人唐文若聞而請對，言不宜急遽，故先下建儲之詔，賜名燁。

translations.literal: Drafting Academician Tang Wenruo heard and requested audience, saying it should not be rushed; therefore the edict establishing the heir was issued first, granting the name Ye.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Wenruo, drafting academician, urged caution; the heir-establishment edict came first, with the name Ye.

sentences.zh: 監察御史周必大密與康伯言，與唐昭宗名同音，不可。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Zhou Bida secretly told Kangbo that it homophonized with Emperor Zhaozong of Tang and was unacceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhou Bida told Kangbo privately that Ye echoed Tang Zhaozong's name and must not stand.

sentences.zh: 詔別擬進，乃定今名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered another name submitted; the present name was then fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered a new name; the present one was chosen.

sentences.zh: 既又命學士承旨洪遵爲太子擇字，遵擬四字以進，皆不稱旨。

translations.literal: Again he ordered Academician Expositor Hong Zun to choose a courtesy name for the crown prince; Zun submitted four characters, none of which pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong again had Hong Zun propose a courtesy name; four were offered and all rejected.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，御筆賜字元永。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu of the sixth month, by imperial brush he was granted the courtesy name Yuanyong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day in the sixth month the emperor wrote the courtesy name Yuanyong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，內降御劄：「皇太子可即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day yihai an edict descended from within: "The crown prince may immediately ascend the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an inner edict read, "The crown prince shall take the throne at once.

sentences.zh: 朕稱太上皇帝，退處德壽宮；

translations.literal: I shall style myself Retired Emperor and withdraw to De'shou Palace;
translations.idiomatic: I shall take the title Retired Emperor and live at De'shou Palace;

sentences.zh: 皇后稱太上皇后。

translations.literal: the empress shall style herself Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: the empress shall be Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，遣中使召帝入禁中，面諭之，帝又推遜不受，即趨側殿門，欲還東宮，高宗勉諭再三，乃止。

translations.literal: " On the day bingzi an inner envoy was sent to summon the emperor into the palace; he was instructed face to face. The emperor again declined and would not accept; he hurried to the side hall gate intending to return to the Eastern Palace. Gaozong urged him again and again before he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingzi day envoys summoned him; Gaozong told him in person. He refused again and made for the Eastern Palace until Gaozong pressed him repeatedly to stay.

sentences.zh: 於是高宗出御紫宸殿，輔臣奏事畢，高宗還宮。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gaozong came out to preside at the Zichen Hall; after the chief ministers finished their business Gaozong returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong then appeared at Zichen Hall; when the ministers had reported, he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 百官移班殿門外，拜詔畢，復入班殿庭。

translations.literal: The hundred officials shifted their formation outside the hall gate; after bowing to the edict they re-entered formation in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Officials moved outside the gate, bowed to the edict, and re-formed in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 頃之，內侍掖帝至御榻前，側立不坐，內侍扶掖至七八，乃略就坐。

translations.literal: Shortly after, inner attendants led the emperor before the imperial couch; he stood to the side and would not sit. The attendants supported him seven or eight times before he barely took his seat.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants brought him to the throne; he stood aside and would not sit until they had steadied him seven or eight times.

sentences.zh: 宰相率百僚稱賀，帝遽興。

translations.literal: The chief minister led the hundred officials in congratulations; the emperor rose at once.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister led felicitations; the new emperor rose immediately.

sentences.zh: 輔臣升殿固請，帝愀然曰：「君父之命，出於獨斷。

translations.literal: The chief ministers ascended the hall and firmly requested; the emperor said with a somber look: "A father's and sovereign's command issues from his sole decision.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers pressed him to be seated; somberly he said, "My father and lord has decided this alone.

sentences.zh: 然此大位，懼不克當。

translations.literal: Yet this great position—I fear I cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I fear I am not equal to so great a charge.

sentences.zh: 」班退，太上皇帝即駕之德壽宮，帝服袍履，步出祥曦殿門，冒雨掖輦以行，及宮門弗止。

translations.literal: " When the session ended the Retired Emperor at once drove to De'shou Palace. The emperor wore robe and shoes, walked out the Xiangxi Hall gate, braved rain to support the carriage on foot, and at the palace gate would not stop.
translations.idiomatic: " When court ended the retired emperor went to De'shou. The new emperor walked out in robe and shoes, held the carriage through rain, and would not turn back at the gate.

sentences.zh: 上皇麾謝再三，且令左右扶掖以還，顧曰：「吾付託得人，吾無憾矣。

translations.literal: The retired emperor waved thanks again and again and ordered those beside him to support him back, turning to say: "I have entrusted it to the right man; I have no regrets.
translations.idiomatic: The retired emperor waved him off, had attendants pull him back, and said, "I leave it to the right man; I have no regret.

sentences.zh: 」左右皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: " Those beside him all shouted "Long live!"
translations.idiomatic: " All around cried "Long may he live!"

sentences.zh: 是日，詔有司議太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號以聞，在內諸司日輪官吏應奉德壽宮，增置，朝德壽宮提點、幹辦等官，德壽宮宿衛依皇城及宮門法。

translations.literal: That day an edict ordered the relevant offices to deliberate the honorific titles of Retired Emperor and Retired Empress and report; inner offices were to rotate officials daily to serve De'shou Palace with added posts—Directors and Administrators for attendance at De'shou Palace; De'shou guards were to follow the laws for the Imperial City and palace gates.
translations.idiomatic: That day orders went out to fix honorific titles and to staff and guard De'shou Palace like the inner city.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相率百官月兩朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the chief minister to lead the hundred officials twice monthly in audience at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister was to lead officials to De'shou twice a month.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以即位告於天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day jimao the accession was announced to Heaven, Earth, the ancestral temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the accession was reported to Heaven, Earth, temples, and altars.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔五日一朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen an edict ordered audience at De'shou Palace every five days.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day court ordered visits to De'shou every five days.

sentences.zh: 以左武大夫龍大淵爲樞密副都承旨，武翼郎曾覿帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Longwu Grand Master Long Dayuan was made Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Martial Wings Gentleman Zeng Di was given charge of imperial arms.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan became deputy commissioner of military affairs; Zeng Di received charge of imperial arms.

sentences.zh: 癸未，始御後殿。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei he began to hold court in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day he began holding court in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔中外士庶陳時政闕失。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen an edict invited scholars and commoners throughout the realm to report failures of policy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day all were invited to report policy failures.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔進宰執官二等。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu an edict advanced chief ministers two grades in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day chief ministers were promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔以太上皇不許五日一朝，自今月四朝。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai an edict said that since the Retired Emperor did not permit visits every five days, from now on there would be four audiences per month.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, because the retired emperor declined five-day visits, four monthly audiences were set.

sentences.zh: 復除名勒停人胡銓官、知饒州。

translations.literal: Hu Quan, whose name had been struck from the rolls and who had been dismissed, was restored to office as prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan, long disgraced and dismissed, was restored as prefect of Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔有司月奉德壽宮緡錢十萬。

translations.literal: On the day jichou an edict ordered the relevant offices to supply one hundred thousand strings of cash monthly to De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day De'shou was granted one hundred thousand strings of cash per month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔罷四川市馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao an edict abolished horse markets in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Sichuan horse markets were abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔百官日一人入對。

translations.literal: On the day renchen an edict ordered one official per day to enter for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day one official a day was to have audience.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，蝗。

translations.literal: On the day guisi there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上太上皇帝尊號曰光堯壽聖太上皇帝，太上皇后曰壽聖太上皇后。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the honorific of the Retired Emperor was fixed as Retired Emperor Guangyao Shousheng, and that of the Retired Empress as Retired Empress Shousheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the retired emperor was titled Guangyao Shousheng Retired Emperor and the empress Shousheng Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 乙未晦，金人屠原州。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, yiwei, the Jurchens slaughtered Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day, yiwei, the Jin massacred Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，興州中軍統制吳挺復鞏州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, Wu Ting, commander of the middle army of Xingzhou, recovered Gongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wuxu day, Wu Ting of Xingzhou recovered Gongzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，判建康府張浚入見。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Zhang Jun, acting prefect of Jiankang, had audience.

sentences.zh: 以雨水、飛蝗，令侍從、台諫條上民間利害。

translations.literal: Because of rain and flying locusts, attendants and remonstrating censors were ordered to list harms and benefits among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Rain and locusts led to orders for attendants and censors to report popular grievances.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔戒飭諸郡守臣。

translations.literal: On the day renyin an edict admonished prefects of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict warned prefects throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以張浚爲少傅、江淮宣撫使，封魏國公。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Zhang Jun was made Junior Tutor and Pacification Commissioner of the Jiang-Huai region, enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Zhang Jun became Junior Tutor and Jiang-Huai pacification commissioner, Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以參知政事汪澈視師湖北、京西。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Participating Administrator Wang Che was sent to inspect the armies of Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Wang Che was sent to oversee Hubei and Jingxi armies.

sentences.zh: 遣劉珙等使金告即位。

translations.literal: Liu Qi and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to announce the accession.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qi and others were sent to the Jin to announce the enthronement.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以四川宣撫使吳璘兼陝西河東路宣撫、招討使。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Wu Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Sichuan, was also made Pacification and Recruiting Commissioner of Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Wu Lin of Sichuan was also made pacifier of Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 追復岳飛元官，以禮改葬。

translations.literal: Yue Fei's original office was posthumously restored and he was reburied with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Fei's rank was posthumously restored and he was reburied with honor.

sentences.zh: 是夜，地震，大風拔木。

translations.literal: That night there was an earthquake; a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: That night the earth shook and a gale uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 己酉，有事於太廟、別廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou there was worship at the Grand Temple and the subsidiary temples.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day rites were held at the Grand Temple and subsidiary shrines.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，馬軍司中軍統制趙撙、忠義軍統領皇甫倜復光州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Zhao Zun, commander of the middle army of the Horse Army Division, and Huangfu Tong, leader of the Loyal and Righteous Army, recovered Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Zhao Zun and Huangfu Tong recovered Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin there was audience presenting offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔淮南諸州存恤淮北來歸之民，權免稅役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huainan circuits to succor people who had come from north of the Huai and temporarily exempt them from taxes and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan prefectures were to aid refugees from north of the Huai and temporarily exempt them from tax and labor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以少保、保康軍節度使吳益爲少傅，太尉、甯武軍節度使吳蓋爲開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Baokang Wu Yi was made Junior Tutor, and Grand Preceptor and Military Commissioner of Ningwu Wu Gai was made Grand Master with the Honor of the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Wu Yi was made Junior Tutor and Wu Gai Grand Master with Three-Duke honors.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷李寶措置海道。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Li Bao's commission over sea routes was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Li Bao's sea-route commission was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊午，恩平郡王璩入見。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Prince of Enping, Wang Shan, entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince of Enping Wang Shan had audience.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以御前軍器所仍隸工部。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the Imperial Front Armory was again placed under the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Imperial Armory returned to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔後省看詳中外上書，有可采者以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou an edict ordered the Secretariat to review memorials from within and without and report what could be adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Secretariat was to review submitted memorials and report what merited adoption.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以黃祖舜兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Huang Zushun was made Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Huang Zushun became acting participating administrator.

sentences.zh: 罷諸路聖節進奉。

translations.literal: Tribute on imperial birthdays from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Birthday tribute from all circuits was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔李顯忠軍馬聽張浚節制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Xianzhong's army and horses to obey Zhang Jun's command.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong's troops were placed under Zhang Jun's command.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，增將士戰傷死者推恩格。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the scale of favors for soldiers wounded or killed in battle was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day benefits for soldiers wounded or killed in battle were enlarged.

sentences.zh: 詔蠲四川積年逋負。

translations.literal: An edict remitted accumulated arrears in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict canceled long-standing tax arrears in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑朔，四川馬軍統制高師中與金人戰于摧沙，敗死。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, yichou, Gao Shizhong, commander of the Sichuan Horse Army, fought the Jurchens at Cuisha and was defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, Gao Shizhong of the Sichuan cavalry fought the Jin at Cuisha, was defeated, and died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吳璘與金人戰於德順軍。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Wu Lin fought the Jurchens at Deshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Wu Lin engaged the Jin at Deshun.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以翰林學士史浩爲參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Academician of the Hanlin Academy Shi Hao was made Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Hanlin academician Shi Hao became participating administrator.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，率群臣詣德壽宮，奉上太上皇帝、太上皇后尊號冊寶。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the emperor led the hundred officials to De'shou Palace and presented the seals and regalia of honorific title to the Retired Emperor and Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day he led the court to De'shou to present honorific seals to the retired emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 于亥，班寬恤事十八條。

translations.literal: On the day yihai eighteen items of lenient relief were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day eighteen measures of clemency were announced.

sentences.zh: 起居舍人洪邁、知閣門事張掄坐奉使辱命罷。

translations.literal: Recorder Hong Mai and Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates Zhang Lun were dismissed for disgracing the mission on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Mai and Zhang Lun were dismissed for failing their embassy.

sentences.zh: 甲申，吳璘敗金人於北山。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Wu Lin defeated the Jurchens at North Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Wu Lin defeated the Jin at North Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊子，追復李光資政殿學土，趙鼎、範沖並還合得恩數。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Li Guang's post as Academician of the Zizheng Hall was posthumously restored; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong also received the favors due them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Li Guang's academician rank was restored; Zhao Ding and Fan Chong received their due honors.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以生日爲會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin the birthday was made the Festival of Congregant Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the emperor's birthday became the Festival of Congregant Celebration.

sentences.zh: 追冊故妃郭氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Guo, deceased, was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: The late Consort Guo was posthumously made empress.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，以子愭爲少保、永興軍節度使，進封鄧王；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiawu, the son Qi was made Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Yongxing, advanced to Prince of Deng;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu day, Prince Qi was made Junior Guardian of Yongxing and advanced to Prince of Deng;

sentences.zh: 愷爲雄武軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封慶王；

translations.literal: Kai was made Military Commissioner of Xiongwu and Grand Master with the Honor of the Three Dukes, advanced to Prince of Qing;
translations.idiomatic: Kai was made Military Commissioner of Xiongwu with Three-Duke honors and advanced to Prince of Qing;

sentences.zh: 惇爲鎮洮軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封恭王。

translations.literal: Dun was made Military Commissioner of Zhentao and Grand Master with the Honor of the Three Dukes, advanced to Prince of Gong.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was made Military Commissioner of Zhentao with Three-Duke honors and advanced to Prince of Gong.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人攻德順軍東山堡，中軍將李庠戰死。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the Jurchens attacked the eastern hill fort of Deshun Army; Middle Army Commander Li Xiang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Jin attacked Deshun's eastern fort; Commander Li Xiang was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔開講日召輔臣觀講。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou an edict ordered that on lecture days the chief ministers be summoned to observe the lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day lectures were opened to the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 川、陝宣諭使虞允文以論邊事不合罷。

translations.literal: Yu Yunwen, Commissioner for Sichuan and Shaanxi, was dismissed because his views on border affairs did not accord.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen, commissioner for Sichuan and Shaanxi, was dismissed over border policy.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔侍從、台諫舉知四川利害可爲都轉運使者。

translations.literal: On the day jihai an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to recommend someone who understood Sichuan's interests and could serve as Director-General of Transport.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day attendants and censors were to recommend a Sichuan transport chief.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以金人來索舊禮，詔宰執、侍從、台諫各陳應敵定論以聞。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, because the Jurchens came demanding the old protocol, an edict ordered chief ministers, attendants, and censors each to state a settled policy for dealing with the enemy and report.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, when the Jin demanded the old rites, ministers were ordered to submit policies for response.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔吳璘審度措置，保全川蜀。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou an edict ordered Wu Lin to assess measures and preserve Sichuan and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Wu Lin was ordered to secure Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔纂錄勳臣名次。

translations.literal: On the day yisi an edict ordered compilation of the order of merit of meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court ordered a register of meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙午，轉補朱震、范衝子孫官。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the sons of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong were transferred to official posts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the sons of Zhu Zhen and Fan Chong received offices.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，諡皇后郭氏曰恭懷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the posthumous title of Empress Guo was fixed as Gonghuai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Empress Guo was given the posthumous title Gonghuai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，振淮東義兵及歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai righteous armies of east Huai and those who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day east-Huai volunteers and defectors were aided.

sentences.zh: 以總領四川財賦軍馬錢糧王之望爲戶部侍郎、川陝宣諭使，仍命將調兵同防守興州川口。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang, Director-General of Sichuan finances, army horses, funds, and grain, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and Commissioner for Sichuan and Shaanxi, and was also ordered to transfer troops to defend the river crossing at Xingzhou with the generals.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang, who oversaw Sichuan supplies, became vice minister and Sichuan-Shaanxi commissioner and was to move troops to guard Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔虞允文赴吳璘軍議事。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict ordered Yu Yunwen to go to Wu Lin's army to deliberate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Yu Yunwen was sent to Wu Lin's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以吳璘爲少師。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Wu Lin was made Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Wu Lin was made Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，詔朝臣舉堪監司、郡守者，戊辰，以岳陽軍節度使居廣開府儀同三司，史浩兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingyin, an edict ordered court officials to recommend those fit to be circuit intendants or prefects. On the day wuchen Military Commissioner of Yueyang Ju Guang was made Grand Master with the Honor of the Three Dukes, and Shi Hao was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingyin day officials were to recommend intendants and prefects; on wuchen Ju Guang received Three-Duke honors and Shi Hao acted as military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，葉義問罷。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Ye Yiwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Ye Yiwen left office.

sentences.zh: 詔登聞鼓院毋沮抑進狀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Court of Imperial Complaints not to obstruct memorials submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The drum court was forbidden to block petitions.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以恩平郡王璩爲少保。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Prince of Enping Wang Shan was made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Prince of Enping Wang Shan became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 詔會慶節權免上壽。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that on the Festival of Congregant Celebration the birthday congratulations be provisionally waived.
translations.idiomatic: Birthday congratulations at the festival were suspended.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔張浚、陳俊卿覆實諸將所陳功賞。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin an edict ordered Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing to verify the merit rewards claimed by the generals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Zhang Jun and Chen Junqing were to verify generals' claims of merit.

sentences.zh: 改諡皇后郭氏曰安穆。

translations.literal: The posthumous title of Empress Guo was changed to Anmu.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Guo's posthumous title was changed to Anmu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，官岳飛孫六人。

translations.literal: On the day renwu six grandsons of Yue Fei were given office.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day six of Yue Fei's grandsons received office.

sentences.zh: 甲申，契丹招討蕭鷓巴來奔。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Xiao Zheba, Pacification Commissioner of the Khitan, came to defect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Khitan pacification commissioner Xiao Zheba defected.

sentences.zh: 金人攻德順城，吳璘擊走之，復遣兵追襲，遂爲所敗。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Deshun city; Wu Lin drove them off, then sent troops in pursuit and was in turn defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Deshun; Wu Lin repulsed them but was defeated when he pursued.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，升建州爲建寧府。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou Jianzhou was elevated to Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Jianzhou became Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以資政殿學士張燾同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Academician of the Zizheng Hall Zhang Tao was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhang Tao became vice commissioner of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，安南都護、南平王同李天祚、闍婆國王悉里地茶蘭固野、占城國王鄒時巴蘭並加食邑實封。

translations.literal: On the day jichou the Protector-General of Annan, Prince of Nanping Tong Li Tianzuo, the king of Java Sidilandi, and the king of Champa Zou Shibalan were all granted increased actual fiefs in their food domains.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the rulers of Annan, Java, and Champa received enlarged fiefs.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，以蕭鷓巴爲忠州團練使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengzi, Xiao Zheba was made Regimental Training Commissioner of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, Xiao Zheba was made regimental commissioner of Zhongzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，金人攻水洛城。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the Jurchens attacked Shuiluo city.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Jin attacked Shuiluo.

sentences.zh: 丙午，賜忠義軍統制皇甫倜軍帛五千匹、綿萬兩。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the Loyal and Righteous Army commander Huangfu Tong was granted five thousand bolts of army cloth and ten thousand liang of cotton.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Huangfu Tong received five thousand bolts of cloth and ten thousand liang of cotton.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔改明年爲隆興元年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen an edict changed the next year to the first year of Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the next year was proclaimed Longxing 1.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，免楊存中所獻酒坊逋負錢四十萬緡。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai four hundred thousand strings of arrears on the wine monopoly Yang Cunzhong had presented were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day four hundred thousand strings of Yang Cunzhong's wine-monopoly debt were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，定內侍官額。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin the quota for inner attendants was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day inner-attendant quotas were set.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，史浩免權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou Shi Hao was relieved of acting as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Shi Hao left the acting military commission.

sentences.zh: 裁定文武臣宮觀、嶽廟員數。

translations.literal: The numbers of civil and military officials holding palace and mountain temple sinecures were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Quotas were set for civil and military holders of sinecure posts.

sentences.zh: 立措置京西營田司。

translations.literal: An office to manage military colonies in western Jing was established.
translations.idiomatic: A western Jing military-colony office was established.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，詔宰臣復兼樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yichou, an edict ordered chief ministers again to hold concurrently the post of Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou day, chief ministers again held the military commission.

sentences.zh: 金人攻隴城縣，官軍拒卻之，丙寅，詔帥臣、監司具部內知州治行臧否以聞。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Longcheng county and were repulsed by government troops. On the day bingyin an edict ordered military commissioners and circuit intendants to report the good and bad conduct of prefects within their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin attacked Longcheng and were repulsed; on bingyin day commanders were to report on prefects.

sentences.zh: 詔棄德順城，徙兵民于秦州以里屯住。

translations.literal: An edict ordered abandonment of Deshun city and relocation of troops and people to Qinzhou for garrison within the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Deshun was abandoned and its people moved inland to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以陳康伯兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Chen Kangbo was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Chen Kangbo became military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 令江、淮宣撫司增招武勇效用軍。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Commission was ordered to increase recruitment of brave and effective troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai pacification office was to recruit more brave troops.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔侍從、台諫集議當今弊事，仍命盡率其屬，使極言無隱。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to assemble and discuss current abuses, and also ordered them to bring all their subordinates so they might speak without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day attendants and censors were to debate abuses openly with their staffs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，劉珙、張說還自盱眙。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Liu Qi and Zhang Yue returned from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蠲四川登極赦前帶白契稅錢。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin tax on white contracts in Sichuan before the accession amnesty was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Sichuan's pre-accession white-contract tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔觀察使已上各舉所知三人，三省、樞密院詳議立格以聞。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu an edict ordered observers and above each to recommend three men they knew; the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs were to deliberate and establish rules and report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day observers were to recommend three men each for rules on promotion.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，罷建康、鎮江營田官兵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin military-colony troops at Jiankang and Zhenjiang were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Jiankang and Zhenjiang colony troops were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廣西賊王宣破藤州，守臣廖顒棄城遁。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Guangxi bandit Wang Xuan took Tengzhou; the defending official Liao Yong abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wang Xuan seized Tengzhou; Liao Yong fled.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸路斷大辟四十一人。

translations.literal: That year, throughout the circuits forty-one persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year forty-one capital sentences were passed in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年春正月壬辰朔，群臣朝於文德殿。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Longxing, on the day renchen, the first day of the month, the hundred officials attended court at Wende Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Longxing 1, on the new year's day, the court assembled at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 帝朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: The emperor attended court at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited De'shou Palace.

sentences.zh: 立武臣薦舉格。

translations.literal: Rules for recommendation of military officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for recommending military officials were set.

sentences.zh: 甲午，四川宣撫司奉詔班師。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the Sichuan Pacification Commission received an edict to withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Sichuan forces were ordered home.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以史浩爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，張浚進樞密使、都督江淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Shi Hao was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Zhang Jun was advanced to Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Commander-in-Chief of the Jiang-Huai eastern and western route armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Shi Hao became chief minister and Zhang Jun commander of Jiang-Huai forces.

sentences.zh: 丙午，誅殿前司後軍謀變者。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu those who plotted mutiny in the rear army of the Palace Front Division were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day mutineers in the Palace Front rear army were executed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔禮部貢院試額增一百人。

translations.literal: On the day wushen an edict increased the examination quota of the Ministry of Rites by one hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the civil examination quota rose by one hundred.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔吳璘軍進退可從便宜。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi an edict ordered that Wu Lin's army might advance or retreat as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wu Lin was given discretion to advance or withdraw.

sentences.zh: 璘已棄德順，道爲金人所邀，將士死者數萬計。

translations.literal: Wu Lin had already abandoned Deshun; on the road he was intercepted by the Jurchens, and soldiers and officers who died numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin had abandoned Deshun; the Jin ambushed his retreat and tens of thousands perished.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌朔，用史浩策，以布衣李信爲兵部員外郎，齎蠟書間道往中原，招豪傑之據有州郡者，許以封王世襲。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renxu, the first day of the month, following Shi Hao's plan, the commoner Li Xin was made Vice Director of the Ministry of War and sent by secret route with a wax-sealed letter through byways to the central plains to recruit heroes holding prefectures and counties, promising enfeoffment as kings with hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu day, Shi Hao's plan sent Li Xin with a secret letter to the north to enlist local lords with promises of hereditary kingship.

sentences.zh: 安慶軍節度使士篯乞減奉賜之半，以助軍用。

translations.literal: Shi Qian, Military Commissioner of Anqing, requested to reduce his salary and stipends by half to aid military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: The Anqing commissioner Shi Qian offered half his salary for the army.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸宗室有請，悉從之。

translations.literal: From this time, whenever members of the imperial clan made such requests, all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter similar requests from the imperial clan were all granted.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宰執陳康伯等乞再減奉，止存舊格之半，許之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Chief Ministers Chen Kangbo and others requested again to reduce salaries, retaining only half the old standard; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the chief ministers halved their salaries by request.

sentences.zh: 己卯，振兩淮流民及山東歸正忠義軍。

translations.literal: On the day jimao refugees of the two Huai and the loyal and righteous armies of Shandong who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Huai refugees and Shandong loyalists were aided.

sentences.zh: 癸未，黃祖舜罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Huang Zushun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Huang Zushun left office.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，逐秦檜黨人，仍禁輒至行在。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin partisans of Qin Hui were expelled and forbidden to come to the temporary capital without permission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Qin Hui's faction was banished from the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，金左副元帥紇石烈志寧以書取侵地。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renchen, the first day of the month, the Jin Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Helushilie Zhining sent a letter demanding return of invaded territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen day, the Jin commander Zhining demanded return of seized lands.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張燾爲參知政事，御史中丞辛次膺同知樞密院事，葉義問落端明殿學士、饒州居住。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Zhang Tao was made Participating Administrator; Vice Censor-in-Chief Xin Ciying was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ye Yiwen was stripped of his Duanming Hall academician title and made to reside at Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhang Tao and Xin Ciying were promoted; Ye Yiwen was demoted to Raozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔戶部置局，議節浮費。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to establish an office to discuss reduction of extravagant expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Revenue Ministry was to cut waste.

sentences.zh: 己亥，楊存中等乞減半奉如宰執例，許之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Yang Cunzhong and others requested to halve salaries as chief ministers did; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Yang Cunzhong and others halved their salaries like the ministers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Long Dayuan was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates; Zeng Di was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Long Dayuan and Zeng Di received gate commissions.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陳康伯上欽宗陵名曰永獻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Chen Kangbo submitted the posthumous temple name of Emperor Qinzong as Yongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Chen Kangbo proposed Qinzong's temple name Yongxian.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔求遺逸。

translations.literal: On the day yisi an edict sought men of hidden talent.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court sought hidden talent.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔修《太上皇帝聖政》。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei an edict ordered compilation of the Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day compilation of the retired emperor's Sagely Governance was ordered.

sentences.zh: 罷龍大淵，別與差遣。

translations.literal: Long Dayuan was dismissed and given another assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Long Dayuan was dismissed and reassigned.

sentences.zh: 曾覿復帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Zeng Di again received charge of imperial arms.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di again received charge of imperial arms.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was summoned.

sentences.zh: 己酉，張燾罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Zhang Tao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Zhang Tao left office.

sentences.zh: 立選人減舉主法。

translations.literal: The law reducing the number of examination sponsors for selectees was established.
translations.idiomatic: Rules reducing sponsors for examination candidates were set.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復龍大淵知閤門事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Long Dayuan was restored as Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Long Dayuan returned to the gate commission.

sentences.zh: 曾覿同閣門事，給事中、中書舍人留黃不行。

translations.literal: Zeng Di was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates; the Attending Drafting Academician and Drafting Academician withheld the yellow copy and would not issue it.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Di's appointment was blocked when drafting officials withheld the edict.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔飭郡縣吏。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict admonished prefectural and county clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day local clerks were admonished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以久雨，命有司振災傷，察刑禁。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, because of prolonged rain, the relevant offices were ordered to relieve disaster victims and review criminal detention.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day prolonged rain led to disaster relief and review of prisons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，定選人改官歲額。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yichou, the annual quota for selectees changing office was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yichou day, annual promotion quotas were set.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，張浚入見，議出師渡淮，三省、樞密院不預聞。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Zhang Jun entered audience and discussed crossing the Huai in campaign; the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs were not consulted beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Zhang Jun proposed crossing the Huai without prior consultation of the ministries.

sentences.zh: 壬申，賜禮部進士木待問以下五百三十八人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day renshen five hundred thirty-eight men from Mu Daiwen down among the Jinshi graduates of the Ministry of Rites were granted passage of the examinations and formal inception.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day five hundred thirty-eight new Jinshi were graduated.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，王之望罷。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Wang Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Wang Zhiwang left office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔戶部、台諫議節浮費。

translations.literal: On the day renwu an edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue and remonstrating censors to discuss reduction of extravagant expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day revenue officials and censors were to cut waste.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔以白金二十五萬兩給江、淮都督府軍費。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei an edict ordered two hundred fifty thousand taels of white silver given to the Jiang-Huai Command Headquarters for military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day two hundred fifty thousand taels of silver were allotted to the Jiang-Huai command.

sentences.zh: 戊子，張浚命邵宏淵帥師次盱眙。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Zhang Jun ordered Shao Hongyuan to lead the army and encamp at Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhang Jun sent Shao Hongyuan to Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，又命李顯忠帥師次定遠。

translations.literal: On the day jichou he again ordered Li Xianzhong to lead the army and encamp at Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Li Xianzhong was sent to Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人拔環州，守臣強霓及其弟震死之。

translations.literal: That month the Jurchens took Huanzhou; the defending official Qiang Ni and his younger brother Zhen died in the defense.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Jin took Huanzhou; Qiang Ni and his brother Zhen died defending it.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，申嚴鋪翠銷金及神祠僭擬之禁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renchen, prohibitions against paving with kingfisher inlay and gold tracery and against presumptuous imitation at spirit shrines were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen day, sumptuary laws on gold-inlaid furnishings and illicit shrines were tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，李顯忠復靈壁縣。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Li Xianzhong recovered Lingbi county.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Li Xianzhong retook Lingbi.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵次虹縣，金人拒之。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan encamped at Hong county; the Jurchens resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan reached Hong county and met Jin resistance.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，顯忠東趨虹縣。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Xianzhong marched east toward Hong county.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Xianzhong advanced on Hong.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復虹縣，金知泗州蒲察徒穆及同知泗州大周仁降。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Hong county was recovered; Pucha Tumu, Jin acting prefect of Sizhou, and Dazhou Ren, vice prefect of Sizhou, surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Hong fell; the Jin prefects of Sizhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，命左右史日更立前殿。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the Left and Right Recorders were ordered to stand daily in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the court recorders were posted daily in the front hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，張浚渡江視師。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Zhang Jun crossed the river to inspect the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Zhang Jun crossed the Yangzi to oversee the armies.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金右翼軍都統蕭琦降于李顯忠。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Xiao Qi, Right Wing Army Commander-in-Chief of the Jin, surrendered to Li Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the Jin commander Xiao Qi surrendered to Li Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，顯忠及宏淵敗金人於宿州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Xianzhong and Hongyuan defeated the Jurchens at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Xianzhong and Hongyuan beat the Jin at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙己，史浩罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Shi Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Shi Hao left office.

sentences.zh: 追復司馬康右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Sima Kang's post as Right Remonstrating Censor was posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Kang's censor rank was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復宿州，戮金兵數千人。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Suzhou was recovered and several thousand Jin soldiers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Suzhou was taken and thousands of Jin troops were killed.

sentences.zh: 建康前軍統領官王珙巷戰，死之。

translations.literal: Wang Gong, commanding officer of the forward army at Jiankang, fought in the lanes and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong of Jiankang's vanguard died fighting in the streets.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以辛次膺爲參知政事，翰林學士承旨洪遵同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Xin Ciying was made Participating Administrator; Academician Expositor Hong Zun was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xin Ciying and Hong Zun were promoted.

sentences.zh: 督諸路開營田。

translations.literal: All circuits were ordered to open military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Military colonies were ordered opened in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詣德壽宮賀天申節。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the emperor went to De'shou Palace to observe the Festival of Heaven's Approval.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor celebrated at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 金紇石烈志甯自睢陽引兵至宿州，李顯忠擊卻之。

translations.literal: The Jin commander Helushilie Zhining led troops from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhining marched from Suiyang to Suzhou; Li Xianzhong drove him back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，欽宗大祥，帝服衰服詣几筵，易祥服行祥祭禮。

translations.literal: On the day renzi was the great mourning for Emperor Qinzong; the emperor wore mourning garments and went to the spirit seat, then changed to auspicious garments and performed the auspicious mourning rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Qinzong's great mourning, the emperor performed the full rite sequence.

sentences.zh: 顯忠與金人戰於宿州，邵宏淵不援，顯忠失利。

translations.literal: Xianzhong fought the Jurchens at Suzhou; Shao Hongyuan did not support him, and Xianzhong suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At Suzhou Xianzhong fought the Jin without Hongyuan's aid and lost.

sentences.zh: 是夜，建康中軍統制周巨集及邵巨集淵之子世雄、殿前司統制官左士淵逃歸。

translations.literal: That night Zhou Ji, commander of the middle army at Jiankang, and Shao Ji, son of Hongyuan, and Zuo Shiyuan, commanding officer of the Palace Front Division, fled back.
translations.idiomatic: That night Zhou Ji, Shao Shixiong, and Zuo Shiyuan fled home.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進李顯忠開府儀同三司、淮南京畿京東河北招討使，邵宏淵檢校少保、甯遠軍節度使、招討副使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Li Xianzhong was advanced to Grand Master with the Honor of the Three Dukes and made Pacification and Recruiting Commissioner of Huainan, the capital region, Jingdong, and Hebei; Shao Hongyuan was made Junior Guardian by inspection, Military Commissioner of Ningyuan, and deputy pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Xianzhong and Hongyuan received grand promotions.

sentences.zh: 金人攻宿州城，顯忠大敗之。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked Suzhou city; Xianzhong inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin assaulted Suzhou; Xianzhong repulsed them heavily.

sentences.zh: 殿前司統制官張訓通等七人、統領官十二人，以二將不葉而遁。

translations.literal: Zhang Xuntong and seven other commanding officers of the Palace Front Division and twelve unit commanders fled because the two generals did not cooperate.
translations.idiomatic: Seven commanders and twelve unit leaders fled over discord between the two generals.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，李顯忠、邵宏淵軍大潰于符離。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin the armies of Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan suffered a great rout at Fuli.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Song army was routed at Fuli.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，下詔親征。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict was issued for a personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the emperor proclaimed a personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召汪澈。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Wang Che was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Wang Che was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以張浚兼都督荆、襄軍馬。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was additionally made Commander-in-Chief of Jing and Xiang armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun also took command of Jing and Xiang forces.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠、邵宏淵至濠州。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong and Shao Hongyuan reached Haozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong and Hongyuan withdrew to Haozhou.

sentences.zh: 張浚以劉寶爲鎮江諸軍都統制。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun made Liu Bao Commander-in-Chief of all armies at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun appointed Liu Bao commander at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以蒲察徒穆、大周仁、蕭琦並爲節度使，徒穆大同軍、周仁彰國軍、琦威塞軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Pucha Tumu, Dazhou Ren, and Xiao Qi were all made Military Commissioners—Tumu of Datong Army, Ren of Zhangguo Army, and Qi of Weisai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the surrendered Jin generals were made military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 遣御前忠勇軍赴都督府。

translations.literal: The Imperial Loyal and Brave Army was dispatched to the Command Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Loyal and Brave Army was sent to headquarters.

sentences.zh: 是月，成都地震三。

translations.literal: That month Chengdu was shaken by three earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chengdu suffered three earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 遣內侍趣上淮東將士功賞。

translations.literal: Inner attendants were dispatched to urge reward of merit for Huaidong officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to expedite Huaidong battle rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Wang Che was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Wang Che left office.

sentences.zh: 張浚乞致仕，且請通好，皆不許。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun requested retirement and also requested restoration of friendly relations; both were denied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun sought retirement and peace; both were refused.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以觀文殿大學士湯思退爲醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture Tang Situ was made Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey and Concurrent Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Tang Situ received a court lecture post.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，召虞允文。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Yu Yunwen was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎周葵爲參知政事。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Zhou Kui was made Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Kui became participating administrator.

sentences.zh: 汪澈落資政殿學士、台州居住。

translations.literal: Wang Che was stripped of his Zizheng Hall academician title and made to reside at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Che was demoted to residence at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，張浚自盱眙還揚州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Zhang Jun returned from Xuyi to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Zhang Jun returned to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，李顯忠罷軍職。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Li Xianzhong was dismissed from military office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Li Xianzhong lost his command.

sentences.zh: 壬申，乙太傅、同安郡王楊存中爲御營使、節制殿前司軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Junior Tutor and Prince of Tong'an Yang Cunzhong was made Imperial Camp Commissioner, controlling Palace Front Division troops.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Yang Cunzhong took charge of the palace armies.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou an edict blamed the emperor himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the emperor issued a self-reproach edict.

sentences.zh: 張浚降授特進，仍前樞密使、江淮東西路宣撫使，官屬各奪二官。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was demoted to Special Court Rank while retaining former Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Jiang-Huai eastern and western Pacification Commissioner; his staff each had two ranks stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was demoted but kept his pacification post; his staff were punished.

sentences.zh: 邵宏淵降武義大夫，職仍舊。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan was demoted to Grand Master of Martial Righteousness while retaining his post.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyuan was demoted one rank but kept his post.

sentences.zh: 詔楊存中先詣建康措置營砦，檢視沿江守備。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yang Cunzhong first to go to Jiankang to arrange camps and inspect defenses along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Cunzhong was sent to fortify Jiankang and the river line.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔展巡幸之期。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin an edict extended the date of the imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the planned imperial tour was postponed.

sentences.zh: 辛次膺罷。

translations.literal: Xin Ciying was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Ciying left office.

sentences.zh: 己卯，李顯忠責授清遠軍節度副使、筠州安置。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Li Xianzhong was punished by appointment as Vice Military Commissioner of Qingyuan and ordered to reside at Yunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Li Xianzhong was banished to Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命浙西副都總管李寶兼御營統制官、措置浙西海道。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Vice Commander-in-Chief of western Zhejiang Li Bao was made Imperial Camp Commander and Commissioner for Zhexi sea routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Li Bao was put in charge of Zhexi sea defense.

sentences.zh: 甲申，右諫議大夫王大寶入封，論移蹕。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Right Remonstrating Censor Wang Dabao entered with a sealed memorial discussing relocation of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Wang Dabao memorialized on moving the capital.

sentences.zh: 以敷文閣學士虞允文爲兵部尚書兼湖北、京西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Academician of the Fuweng Pavilion Yu Yunwen was made Minister of War and Commissioner for Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen became war minister and Hubei-Jingxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊子，放宮人三十人。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi thirty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day thirty palace women were freed.

sentences.zh: 以蕭琦爲檢校少保、河北招撫使。

translations.literal: Xiao Qi was made Junior Guardian by inspection and Pacification Commissioner of Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Qi was made Hebei pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅朔，以虞允文爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengyin, the first day of the month, Yu Yunwen was made Commissioner for Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengyin day, Yu Yunwen became Hubei-Jingxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以湯思退爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Tang Situ was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Tang Situ became chief minister.

sentences.zh: 李顯忠再責授果州團練副使、潭州安置。

translations.literal: Li Xianzhong was again punished by appointment as Vice Regimental Training Commissioner of Guozhou and ordered to reside at Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhong was further demoted to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔宿州棄軍將佐奪官、貶竄有差。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei an edict ordered that officers and soldiers who abandoned Suzhou have their offices stripped and be exiled in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Suzhou deserters were punished and exiled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Venus was visible crossing the sky at noon.

sentences.zh: 罷江、淮宣撫司便宜行事。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Huai Pacification Commission's authority to act as circumstances required was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commission lost discretionary powers.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以旱蝗、星變，詔侍從、台諫、兩省官條上時政闕失。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, because of drought, locusts, and celestial anomalies, an edict ordered attendants, remonstrating censors, and officials of the two inner departments to list failures of current policy.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day drought, locusts, and omens led to calls for policy critique.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔征李顯忠侵欺官錢金銀，免籍其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei an edict ordered investigation of Li Xianzhong's embezzlement of official gold and silver, but exempted confiscation of his household registers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xianzhong's embezzlement was investigated without family confiscation.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，裁減省、部、寺、監官吏。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the officials of the departments, ministries, directorates, and commissions were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day central government staff were cut.

sentences.zh: 戊午，給還岳飛田宅。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Yue Fei's fields and residence were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Yue Fei's property was restored.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，張浚復都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Zhang Jun again became Commander-in-Chief of Jiang and Huai armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, Zhang Jun resumed Jiang-Huai command.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以劉寶兼淮東招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Liu Bao was made concurrent Pacification Commissioner of Huaidong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Liu Bao also pacified Huaidong.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以飛蝗、風水爲災，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, because of flying locusts and wind and flood disasters, the emperor left the hall and reduced his meals.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day locusts and floods led the emperor to reduce court and diet.

sentences.zh: 罷借諸路職田之令。

translations.literal: The order to borrow official fields from all circuits was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The borrowing of circuit official fields was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，金紇石烈志寧又以書求海、泗、唐、鄧四州地及歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the Jin Helushilie Zhining again sent a letter demanding the four prefectures of Hai, Si, Tang, and Deng and the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Jin again demanded four prefectures and tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復以龍大淵知閣門事，曾覿同知閣門事。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Long Dayuan was again made Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates; Zeng Di was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Gates.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Long Dayuan and Zeng Di returned to the gate offices.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣淮西安撫司幹辦公事盧仲賢等齎書至金帥府，戒勿許四州，差減歲幣。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Lu Zhongxian and others of the Huai'an Pacification Commission were sent with a letter to the Jin command, instructed not to concede the four prefectures and to reduce the annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Lu Zhongxian was sent to the Jin with strict negotiating limits.

sentences.zh: 仍命諸將毋遣兵人出境。

translations.literal: The generals were also ordered not to send troops across the border.
translations.idiomatic: Generals were forbidden to cross the border.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，楊存中罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiyou, Yang Cunzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou day, Yang Cunzhong left office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午朔，大臣奏金帥書言四事，帝曰：「四州地、歲幣可與，名分、歸正人不可從。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuwu, the first day of the month, the chief ministers memorialized the Jin commander's letter stating four matters. The emperor said: "The four prefectures and the annual tribute may be granted; title and those who have returned to allegiance cannot be conceded.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the ministers reported the Jin terms; the emperor would yield land and tribute but not status or defectors.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: " On the day xinyou the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day normal court diet resumed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，遣護聖軍戍江南。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the Imperial Guard Army was dispatched to garrison Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Imperial Guard was sent south.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔慶上皇后教旨改稱聖旨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi an edict ordered that instructions of the Retired Empress be styled sage instructions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the retired empress's orders were styled sage instructions.

sentences.zh: 立賢妃夏氏爲皇后。

translations.literal: Consort Xian was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Xian was made empress.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，升洪州爲隆興府。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Hongzhou was elevated to Longxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Hongzhou became Longxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔：「江、淮軍馬調發應援，從都督府取旨，餘事悉以聞。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Dispatch of Jiang and Huai troops for mutual support shall follow orders from the Command Headquarters; all other matters are to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: An edict centralized troop dispatch under the command headquarters.

sentences.zh: 」十一月己丑，盧仲賢自宿州以金都元帥僕散忠義遺三省、樞密院書來。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month, on the day jichou, Lu Zhongxian returned from Suzhou with a letter from the Jin Commander-in-Chief Pusan Zhongyi to the Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lu Zhongxian returned from Suzhou with Pusan Zhongyi's letter.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣王子望等爲金國通問使。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Wang Ziwang and others were dispatched as envoys to inquire of the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Wang Ziwang's embassy was sent to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔侍從、台諫於後省集議講和、遣使、禮數、土貢四事，仍各薦可備小使者。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to assemble at the Secretariat to discuss peace, dispatch of envoys, protocol, and tribute, and each to recommend men fit to serve as minor envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the court debated peace terms and envoy lists.

sentences.zh: 丙午，盧仲賢擅許四州，下大理寺，奪三官。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Lu Zhongxian on his own authority conceded the four prefectures; he was sent to the Court of Judicial Review and stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Lu Zhongxian was punished for conceding the four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 召張浚。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was summoned.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以胡昉、楊由義爲使金通問國信所審議官。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Hu Fang and Yang Youyi were made deliberating officers of the Office for Reviewing Credentials of Envoys to the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Hu Fang and Yang Youyi reviewed Jin credentials.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，陳康伯罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiwei, Chen Kangbo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei day, Chen Kangbo left office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，張浚入見。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Zhang Jun entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Zhang Jun had audience.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以湯思退爲尚書左僕射，張浚爲右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Tang Situ was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Zhang Jun was made Right Vice Director; both were Associate Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery and Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
