translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Tang Situ and Zhang Jun became chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 浚仍都督江、淮東西路軍馬。

translations.literal: Jun still commanded Jiang and Huai eastern and western route armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun retained Jiang-Huai command.

sentences.zh: 壬午，西南方有白氣。

translations.literal: On the day renwu white vapor appeared in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day white vapor appeared in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以兩浙大水、旱蝗，江東大水，悉蠲其租。

translations.literal: That year, because of great floods in the two Zhe regions, drought and locusts, and great floods in Jiangdong, all rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year rents were remitted across the flooded and drought-stricken southeast.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛卯，詔增德壽宮車輦儀衛。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the day xinmao, an edict increased the carriage guard and insignia of De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2, on xinmao day, De'shou's guard was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御文德殿，冊皇后。

translations.literal: On the day renchen the emperor presided at Wende Hall and enfeoffed the empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the empress was enthroned at Wende Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，修三省法。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the regulations of the Three Departments were revised.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Three Departments code was revised.

sentences.zh: 乙未，及皇后朝德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei the empress also attended court at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the empress visited De'shou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命虞允文調兵討廣西諸盜。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Yu Yunwen was ordered to transfer troops to suppress the various bandits of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yu Yunwen was sent against Guangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷諸州招軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi recruitment of soldiers in all prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day prefectural recruitment was ended.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金僕散忠義復以書來。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu the Jin Pusan Zhongyi again sent a letter.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Pusan Zhongyi wrote again.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，申嚴卿監、郎官更出迭入之制。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the system of rotation in and out for directors and subdirectors and for bureau officials was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day rotation rules for central officials were tightened.

sentences.zh: 壬子，振歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day renzi those who had returned to allegiance were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day defectors were aided.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 是月，福建諸州地震。

translations.literal: That month all prefectures of Fujian were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fujian shook with earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，蠲秀州貧民逋租。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinwei, overdue rents of poor households in Xiuzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinwei day, Xiuzhou poor were forgiven rent arrears.

sentences.zh: 壬申，容州妖賊李雲作亂。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the demonic bandit Li Yun of Rongzhou rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Li Yun rebelled at Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，復王權武義大夫，命權廣西路都鈐轄，專一措置盜賊。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Wang Quan was restored to Grand Master of Martial Righteousness and ordered to act as Commander-in-Chief of all Guangxi routes, exclusively to manage the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Wang Quan was restored and sent to suppress Guangxi bandits.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔飭將帥減文武官及百司吏郊賜之半。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi an edict admonished generals to reduce by half the suburban gifts to civil and military officials and clerks of all offices.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day suburban gifts to officials were halved.

sentences.zh: 罷兩浙、福建、江西、湖南、夔州路參議官。

translations.literal: Participating commissioners of the two Zhe circuits, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Kuizhou route were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Participating commissioners in several circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨雹及雪。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou hail and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day hail and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 獲李雲，其党悉平。

translations.literal: Li Yun was captured and his party was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yun was taken and his followers crushed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，胡昉自宿州還。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Hu Fang returned from Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，金帥以昉等不許四郡，械系之，昉等不屈，金主命歸之。

translations.literal: Earlier the Jin commander, because Fang and others would not concede the four prefectures, had them shackled; they did not yield, and the Jin ruler ordered them returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin had shackled Hu Fang's party over the four prefectures; their defiance won their release.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，詔張浚視師於淮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingxu, the first day of the month, an edict ordered Zhang Jun to inspect the armies on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, Zhang Jun was sent to the Huai front.

sentences.zh: 又詔王之望等以幣還。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered Wang Zhiwang and others to return with the tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang's mission was ordered to bring the tribute back.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔荆襄、川陝帥臣嚴邊備，毋先事妄舉。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai an edict ordered military commissioners of Jingxiang and Chuan-Shaan to tighten border defense and not act rashly before events.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day border commanders were warned against rash action.

sentences.zh: 盧仲賢除名，械送郴州編管。

translations.literal: Lu Zhongxian was struck from the rolls, placed in the cangue, and exiled under guard to Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhongxian was disgraced and exiled to Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅。

translations.literal: On the day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day.

sentences.zh: 詔知光州皇甫倜毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huangfu Tong, prefect of Guangzhou, not to recruit those who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Tong at Guangzhou was forbidden to recruit defectors.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王宣等降。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Wang Xuan and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wang Xuan surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔三衙戍兵歸司，建康、鎮江大軍更番歸砦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered garrison troops of the Three Yamen guards to return to their offices; the great armies of Jiankang and Zhenjiang were to rotate in turn back to their camps.
translations.idiomatic: Guard troops returned to barracks; Jiankang and Zhenjiang armies rotated home.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，芝生德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu auspicious fungus grew at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day auspicious fungus appeared at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎錢端禮爲淮東宣諭使，吏部侍郎王之望爲淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Qian Duanli was made Huaidong Commissioner; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Zhiwang was made Huaixi Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Duanli and Wang Zhiwang became Huai commissioners.

sentences.zh: 詔撫諭兩淮軍民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered reassurance of troops and people of the two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai were ordered reassured.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以廣西賊平，詔減高、藤、雷、容四州雜犯死罪囚，釋杖以下，蠲夏秋稅賦。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, because the Guangxi bandits were pacified, an edict reduced capital prisoners guilty of miscellaneous offenses in the four prefectures of Gao, Teng, Lei, and Rong, released those below the rod, and remitted summer and autumn taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Guangxi amnesty followed the bandit pacification.

sentences.zh: 以忠勇軍隸步軍司，神勁右軍隸鎮江都統司。

translations.literal: The Loyal and Brave Army was placed under the Infantry Division; the Divine Stalwart Right Army was placed under the Zhenjiang Command Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Two armies were reassigned to infantry and Zhenjiang command.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以王彥爲建康諸軍都統制兼淮西招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Wang Yan was made Commander-in-Chief of all Jiankang armies and concurrent Pacification Commissioner of Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Wang Yan took Jiankang and Huaixi command.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，召張浚還朝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengshen, Zhang Jun was summoned back to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengshen day, Zhang Jun was recalled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以李顯忠侵欺官錢給還諸軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the official money Li Xianzhong had embezzled was returned to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Xianzhong's embezzled funds were returned to the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以建康歸正人爲忠毅軍，鎮江爲忠順軍，命蕭琦、蕭鷓巴分領之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao those who had returned to allegiance at Jiankang were made the Loyal and Resolute Army, and those at Zhenjiang the Loyal and Obedient Army; Xiao Qi and Xiao Zheba were ordered to command them respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Jiankang and Zhenjiang defectors became two loyal armies under the Xiao brothers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷江、淮都督府。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the Jiang-Huai Command Headquarters was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Jiang-Huai command was abolished.

sentences.zh: 高麗入貢。

translations.literal: Koryo presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Koryo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張浚罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Zhang Jun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Zhang Jun left office.

sentences.zh: 癸未，言者論宰相、執政徇欺之弊，命書寘政事堂。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei remonstrators discussed the abuse of indulging deceit by the chief minister and administrators; they were ordered to write and post it in the Hall of Administration.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day memorials on ministerial deceit were posted in the administration hall.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，復置環衛官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renchen, imperial guard offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen day, imperial guard posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔吳璘毋招納歸正人。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen an edict ordered Wu Lin not to recruit those who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Wu Lin was forbidden to recruit defectors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔劉寶量度泗州輕重取捨事宜以聞。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou an edict ordered Liu Bao to assess the importance of Sizhou and report what should be kept or abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Liu Bao was to report on holding Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 江西總管邵宏淵責授靖州團練副使、南安軍安置，仍征其盜用庫錢。

translations.literal: Shao Hongyuan, Commander-in-Chief of Jiangxi, was punished by appointment as Vice Regimental Training Commissioner of Jingzhou and ordered to reside at Nan'an, and was still required to repay treasury money he had embezzled.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Hongyuan was banished to Nan'an and made to repay stolen funds.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，率群臣詣德壽宮賀天申節，始用樂。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the emperor led the hundred officials to De'shou Palace to observe the Festival of Heaven's Approval; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court celebrated at De'shou with music for the first time.

sentences.zh: 丁未，蝗。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei there were locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day locusts appeared.

sentences.zh: 詔內外贓私不法官吏，尚書省置籍檢勘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that corrupt officials inside and outside who violated the law be registered and investigated by the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of State Affairs was to register corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷招神勁效用軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu recruitment of the Divine Stalwart Effective Army was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Divine Stalwart recruitment ended.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鬻兩淮所招戶馬。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai household horses recruited in the two Huai were sold off.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Huai household horses were sold.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiayin, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以淫雨，詔州縣理滯囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, because of excessive rain, an edict ordered prefectures and counties to clear delayed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day prolonged rain led to review of delayed cases.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命虞允文棄唐、鄧，允文不奉詔。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng; Yunwen did not obey the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Yu Yunwen was ordered to abandon Tang and Deng but refused.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，振江東、兩淮被水貧民。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou poor people of Jiangdong and the two Huai who had suffered flood were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day flood victims in Jiangdong and the Huai were aided.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，召虞允文。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yiyou, Yu Yunwen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yiyou day, Yu Yunwen was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書韓仲通爲湖北、京西制置使。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Han Zhongtong was made Commissioner for Hubei and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhongtong became Hubei-Jingxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，洪遵罷。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Hong Zun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Hong Zun left office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以周葵兼權知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Zhou Kui was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhou Kui acted as military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遣主管馬軍司公事張守忠以兵詣淮西，措置邊備。

translations.literal: Supervisor of Horse Army Affairs Zhang Shouzhong was dispatched with troops to Huaixi to arrange border defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shouzhong was sent with troops to Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 詔內外文武官年七十不請致仕者，遇郊毋得蔭補。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that civil and military officials inside and outside who reached seventy and did not request retirement should not receive hereditary appointment at suburban rites.
translations.idiomatic: Officials over seventy who would not retire lost hereditary appointment rights.

sentences.zh: 乙巳。

translations.literal: On the day yisi.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day.

sentences.zh: 命海、泗州徹戍。

translations.literal: Hai and Sizhou were ordered to withdraw garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Garrisons at Hai and Sizhou were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，蠲淮東內庫坊場錢一年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen levies on Huaidong inner-store monopoly shops were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Huaidong monopoly levies were forgiven for a year.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，洪遵落端明殿學士。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Hong Zun was stripped of his Duanming Hall academician title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Hong Zun lost his academician title.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以江東、浙西大水，詔侍從、台諫、卿監、郎官、館職陳闕失及當今急務。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, because of great floods in Jiangdong and western Zhe, an edict ordered attendants, remonstrating censors, directors, subdirectors, bureau officials, and academy appointees to report failures and urgent matters of the day.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day floods led to calls for policy memorials.

sentences.zh: 是月，罷內侍押班梁珂爲在外宮觀。

translations.literal: That month Inner Attendant Deputy Squad Leader Liang Ke was dismissed and made to hold an outside palace or mountain temple sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: That month Liang Ke was sent to an outside sinecure.

sentences.zh: 移廣西提刑司于容州。

translations.literal: The Guangxi judicial intendant's office was moved to Rongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi judicial office moved to Rongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiashen.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen day.

sentences.zh: 罷內侍李珂賜諡。

translations.literal: Inner Attendant Li Ke was dismissed from being granted a posthumous title.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ke was denied a posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔江東、浙西監司、守臣講明措置田事。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu an edict ordered Jiangdong and western Zhe intendants and prefects to clarify measures for managing fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Jiangdong and Zhe officials were to reform field policy.

sentences.zh: 乙未，交阯入貢。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Jiaozhi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Jiaozhi sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，嚴髒吏法。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou laws against corrupt officials were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day anti-corruption laws were tightened.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以王之望爲參知政事，權刑部侍郎吳芾爲給事中兼淮西宣諭使。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Wang Zhiwang was made Participating Administrator; Vice Minister of Punishments Wu Bi was made Drafting Academician and Huaixi Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Wang Zhiwang and Wu Bi were promoted.

sentences.zh: 金人犯邊。

translations.literal: The Jurchens invaded the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin invaded the border.

sentences.zh: 以久雨，出內庫白金四十萬兩，糴米賑貧民。

translations.literal: Because of prolonged rain, four hundred thousand taels of white silver from the inner treasury were released to buy rice and relieve poor people.
translations.idiomatic: Prolonged rain led to rice relief from the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，王彥帥師濟江，軍昭關。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Wang Yan led the army across the river and encamped at Zhaoguan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Wang Yan crossed the Yangzi to Zhaoguan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: On the day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day.

sentences.zh: 命湯思退都督江、淮東西路軍馬，辭不行。

translations.literal: Tang Situ was ordered Commander-in-Chief of Jiang and Huai eastern and western route armies but declined to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situ was named commander but refused.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，復命楊存中爲同都督，錢端禮、吳芾並爲都督府參贊軍事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Yang Cunzhong was again made Co-Commander; Qian Duanli and Wu Bi were both made staff officers of the Command Headquarters assisting in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Yang Cunzhong returned as co-commander with Qian and Wu as staff.

sentences.zh: 罷宣諭司。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 仍易國書以付魏杞。

translations.literal: The state letter was also changed and given to Wei Qi.
translations.idiomatic: The state letter was revised and entrusted to Wei Qi.

sentences.zh: 少保、崇信軍節度使趙密落致仕，權領殿前司職事。

translations.literal: Junior Guardian and Military Commissioner of Chongxin Zhao Mi was stripped of retirement status and temporarily held Palace Front Division duties.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Mi left retirement to head the Palace Front Division.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，魏杞至盱眙，金帥以國書未如式，弗受，欲得商、秦地及俘獲人，且邀歲幣三十萬，杞未得進。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiayin, Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin commander, because the state letter was not in proper form, would not receive it and wanted the prefectures of Shang and Qin and captives, and moreover demanded three hundred thousand strings in annual tribute; Qi could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wei Qi reached Xuyi; the Jin rejected his letter and demanded more.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賀允中罷爲資政殿大學士致仕。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao He Yunzhong was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture with retirement status.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day He Yunzhong retired.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以周葵兼權知樞密院事，王之望兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Zhou Kui was made Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wang Zhiwang was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Zhou Kui and Wang Zhiwang took military posts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔輔臣夕對便殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu an edict ordered chief ministers to attend in the evening at the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day ministers were to evening audience.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi a great wind blew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day a great gale blew.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲京西、湖北運糧所經州縣秋稅之半。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen half the autumn tax of prefectures and counties along the grain transport routes of western Jing and Hubei was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day transport-route taxes were halved.

sentences.zh: 以靖海軍節度使李寶爲沿海駐紮御前水軍都統制。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner of Jinghai Li Bao was made Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Front Navy stationed on the coast.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bao was made coastal navy commander.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，金人分道渡淮，劉寶棄楚州遁。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the Jurchens crossed the Huai in separate columns; Liu Bao abandoned Chuzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Jin crossed the Huai; Liu Bao fled Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，知楚州魏勝與金人戰，死之，州遂陷，濠州亦陷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, Wei Sheng, prefect of Chuzhou, fought the Jurchens and died; the prefecture then fell, and Haozhou also fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wei Sheng died defending Chuzhou; Chuzhou and Haozhou fell.

sentences.zh: 王彥棄昭關遁，滁州又陷，丙戌，詔諭沿邊將士。

translations.literal: Wang Yan abandoned Zhaoguan and fled; Chuzhou also fell. On the day bingxu an edict exhorted border generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yan fled; Chuzhou fell; on bingxu day border troops were exhorted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔魏祀等以所齎禮幣犒軍。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai an edict ordered Wei Qi and others to use the tribute goods they carried to reward the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Wei Qi was to use tribute to reward troops.

sentences.zh: 杞弗從，命留鎮江侯旨。

translations.literal: Qi would not obey and was ordered to remain at Zhenjiang awaiting instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Qi refused and was held at Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 復命王之望督視江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was again ordered to supervise Jiang and Huai armies.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang was again sent to oversee the Huai armies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以金人侵擾，詔郊杞改用明年。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, because of Jin harassment, an edict ordered the suburban sacrifice moved to the next year.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the suburban rite was postponed for the Jin invasion.

sentences.zh: 又詔諭歸正官民軍士。

translations.literal: Another edict exhorted officials, people, and soldiers who had returned to allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Defectors and troops were again exhorted.

sentences.zh: 命王之望同都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: Wang Zhiwang was ordered Co-Commander of Jiang and Huai armies.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang became co-commander on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 湯思退罷都督。

translations.literal: Tang Situ was dismissed from command.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Situ left the command.

sentences.zh: 召陳康伯。

translations.literal: Chen Kangbo was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Kangbo was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王之望罷同都督。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Wang Zhiwang was dismissed as Co-Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Wang Zhiwang left the co-command.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，命楊存中都督江、淮軍馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Yang Cunzhong was ordered Commander-in-Chief of Jiang and Huai armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yang Cunzhong took Jiang-Huai command.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，湯思退罷，尋以尹穡、晁公武論之，落觀文殿大學士、永州居住，未至而卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Tang Situ was dismissed; shortly afterward, because Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu criticized him, he was stripped of Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and made to reside at Yongzhou; he died before arriving.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Tang Situ fell; Yin Ji and Chao Gongwu's attacks sent him to Yongzhou, where he died en route.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以黃榜禁太學生伏闕。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu a yellow placard forbade Imperial University students to lie prostrate at the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day students were forbidden to petition at the gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，太學生張觀等七十二人上書，請斬湯思退、王之望、尹穡，竄其党洪適、晁公武而用陳康伯、胡銓等，以濟大計。

translations.literal: That day Imperial University students Zhang Guan and seventy-two others submitted a memorial requesting execution of Tang Situ, Wang Zhiwang, and Yin Ji, exile of their faction Hong Shi and Chao Gongwu, and employment of Chen Kangbo, Hu Quan, and others to advance the great plan.
translations.idiomatic: That day seventy-three students demanded execution of peace ministers and restoration of war party leaders.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣國信所大通事王抃持周葵書如金帥府，請正皇帝號，爲叔侄之國；

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Grand Messenger Wang Bian of the Office for Credentials was sent with Zhou Kui's letter to the Jin command, requesting correction of the imperial title and a state of uncle and nephew;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Wang Bian carried Zhou Kui's letter seeking uncle-nephew relations;

sentences.zh: 易歲貢爲歲幣，減十萬；

translations.literal: annual tribute was changed to annual payment, reduced by one hundred thousand;
translations.idiomatic: tribute became "payment," cut by one hundred thousand;

sentences.zh: 割商、秦地；

translations.literal: the prefectures of Shang and Qin were ceded;
translations.idiomatic: Shang and Qin were to be ceded;

sentences.zh: 歸被俘人，惟叛亡者不與；

translations.literal: captives were returned, except deserters and fugitives were not included;
translations.idiomatic: captives would return, but not deserters;

sentences.zh: 誓目大略與紹興同。

translations.literal: the oath in general followed that of Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: the oath largely followed Shaoxing terms.

sentences.zh: 以金人犯淮南，詔避殿減膳。

translations.literal: Because the Jurchens invaded Huainan, an edict ordered leaving the hall and reducing meals.
translations.idiomatic: Jin invasion of Huainan led to reduced court and diet.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔擇日視師。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou an edict ordered a day chosen for inspecting the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day a date was set for inspecting troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以少保、觀文殿大學士陳康伯爲尚書左僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Junior Guardian and Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture Chen Kangbo was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Chen Kangbo became chief minister.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣兵部侍郎胡銓、右諫議大夫尹穡分詣兩浙措置海道。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Vice Minister of War Hu Quan and Right Remonstrating Censor Yin Ji were separately sent to the two Zhe circuits to manage sea routes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Hu Quan and Yin Ji were sent to manage Zhe sea routes.

sentences.zh: 贈魏勝甯國軍節度使，諡忠壯。

translations.literal: Wei Sheng was posthumously made Military Commissioner of Ningguo; his posthumous title was Zhongzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Sheng was posthumously honored as Zhongzhuang, commissioner of Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，兵部尚書錢端禮賜出身，簽書樞密院事兼提領德壽宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Minister of War Qian Duanli was granted formal inception and made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Qian Duanli entered the military commission and oversaw De'shou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔侍從、兩省官日一至都堂議事，有關台諫者亦聽會議。

translations.literal: On the day renyin an edict ordered attendants and officials of the two inner departments daily to come once to the Secretariat to discuss affairs; remonstrating censors related to the matter might also attend.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day ministers were to meet daily at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以顯謨閣學士虞允文同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion Yu Yunwen was made Concurrent Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yunwen became concurrent military signatory.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣王之望勞師江上。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Wang Zhiwang was dispatched to reward the armies on the river.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Wang Zhiwang was sent to reward river armies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，金人犯六合縣，步軍司統制崔皋擊卻之。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Jurchens invaded Liuhe county; Infantry Division Commander Cui Gao repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Cui Gao repulsed the Jin at Liuhe.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以錢端禮兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Qian Duanli was made Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Qian Duanli became acting participating administrator.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以顯謨閣直學士沈介爲沿江制置使。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Academician of the Xianmo Pavilion Shen Jie was made Commissioner for the Riverine Defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Shen Jie became riverine commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命沿江諸州調保甲分守渡口。

translations.literal: Riverine prefectures were ordered to mobilize local militia to guard crossings in shifts.
translations.idiomatic: River prefectures were to rotate militia at crossings.

sentences.zh: 己酉，劉寶落節鉞，爲武泰軍承宣使，王彥落龍神衛四廂都指揮使。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Liu Bao was stripped of command seals and made Palace Provisioner of Wutai; Wang Yan was stripped of command of the four wings of the Dragon Divine Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Liu Bao and Wang Yan lost their commands.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，陳康伯入見，詔康伯間日一朝，肩輿至殿門，給扶升殿。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiayin, Chen Kangbo entered audience; an edict ordered Kangbo to attend court every other day; he was carried in a shoulder carriage to the hall gate and given support to ascend the hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Chen Kangbo was granted every-other-day audience with carriage support.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，周葵罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen Zhou Kui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhou Kui left office.

sentences.zh: 王抃見金二帥，皆得其報書以歸。

translations.literal: Wang Bian met the two Jin commanders and returned with their reply letters.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bian met both Jin commanders and brought back their replies.

sentences.zh: 戊午，蕭琦卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Xiao Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Xiao Qi died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌。

translations.literal: On the day renxu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day.

sentences.zh: 詔罷胡銓、尹穡。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Hu Quan and Yin Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Quan and Yin Ji were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召韓仲通。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Han Zhongtong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Han Zhongtong was summoned.

sentences.zh: 以沈介爲兵部尚書、湖北京西制置使。

translations.literal: Shen Jie was made Minister of War and Commissioner for Huguang and western Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Jie became war minister and Huguang-Jingxi commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以金人且退，詔督府擇利擊之，王之望執不可。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, because the Jurchens were about to withdraw, an edict ordered the Command Headquarters to strike where advantageous; Wang Zhiwang insisted it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the command was ordered to strike the retreating Jin; Wang Zhiwang refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥。

translations.literal: On the day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day.

sentences.zh: 之望罷。

translations.literal: Zhiwang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhiwang left office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以王抃爲奉使金國通問國信所參議官，持陳康伯報書以行。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Wang Bian was made Deliberating Officer of the Office for Reviewing Credentials as envoy to the Jin, carrying Chen Kangbo's reply and departing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Wang Bian was sent with Chen Kangbo's reply.

sentences.zh: 丁丑。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day.

sentences.zh: 金遣張恭愈來迓使者。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Zhang Gongyu to welcome the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Zhang Gongyu to meet the envoy.

sentences.zh: 詔台諫、侍從、兩省官舉楚、廬、滁、濠四州守臣。

translations.literal: An edict ordered remonstrating censors, attendants, and officials of the two inner departments to recommend prefects for Chu, Lu, Chu, and Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were to recommend prefects for four Huai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，罷陝西路轉運司。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiashen, the Shaanxi route transport commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Shaanxi transport office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，魏杞始渡淮。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Wei Qi first crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Wei Qi first crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 詔郊祀大禮遵至道典故，改用來年正月一日上辛。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the great suburban rite to follow the precedents of Zhidao and changed it to the first upper xin day of the first month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: The suburban rite was rescheduled to the coming year's first month.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以錢端禮爲參知政事兼知樞密院事，虞允文同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，禮部尚書王剛中簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Qian Duanli was made Participating Administrator and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Yunwen was Vice Commissioner and Acting Participating Administrator; Minister of Rites Wang Gangzhong was Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Qian, Yu, and Wang took top posts.

sentences.zh: 丙申，制曰：「比遣王抃，遠抵潁濱，得其要約。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen an imperial order said: "Recently Wang Bian was sent far to Yingbin and obtained their essential agreement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict announced Wang Bian's treaty terms:

sentences.zh: 尋澶淵盟誓之信，仿大遼書題之儀，正皇帝之稱，爲叔侄之國，歲幣減十萬之數，地界如紹興之時。

translations.literal: Following the sworn faith of Chanyuan, imitating the style of titles of the Great Liao, correcting the imperial title, making a state of uncle and nephew, reducing annual payment by one hundred thousand, and boundaries as in Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Chanyuan-style faith, Liao-style titles, uncle-nephew relations, reduced payment, Shaoxing borders.

sentences.zh: 憐彼此之無辜，約叛亡之不遣，可使歸正之士咸起甯居之心。

translations.literal: Pitying the innocence on both sides, agreeing not to send back deserters and fugitives, can make those who have returned to allegiance all rise with hearts of tranquil dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: Exempting deserters from return was meant to reassure loyalists.

sentences.zh: 重念數州之民，罹此一時之難，老稚有蕩析之災，丁壯有系累之苦，宜推蕩滌之宥，少慰凋殘之情。

translations.literal: Thinking again of the people of several prefectures who suffered this moment's hardship—old and young had the disaster of dispersion, strong adults the suffering of bondage—there should be extended the grace of sweeping clean, slightly to comfort feelings of ruin and injury.
translations.idiomatic: Border peoples who had suffered war were to receive clemency.

sentences.zh: 應沿邊被兵州軍，除逃遁官吏不赦外，雜犯死罪情輕者減一等，餘並放遣。

translations.literal: For prefectures and armies along the border that had suffered military action, except fleeing officials were not amnestied; miscellaneous capital crimes where the circumstances were light were reduced one grade; the rest were all released.
translations.idiomatic: Border amnesty excepted fleeing officials and lightened other sentences.

sentences.zh: 」遣洪適等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: " Hong Shi and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Shi's embassy congratulated the Jin ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 詔吳挺市馬赴行在。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wu Ting to purchase horses for the temporary capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Ting was to buy horses for the court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day jihai hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，罷三衙、江上、荆襄諸軍招軍。

translations.literal: On the day renyin recruitment by the Three Yamen guards, river armies, and Jingxiang armies was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day army recruitment was halted.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣沿海水軍還屯。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen coastal naval forces were sent back to garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the coastal navy returned to base.

sentences.zh: 己酉，朝獻景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou offerings were presented at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day offerings were at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，朝饗太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu the Grand Temple was presented with offerings.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the Grand Temple received offerings.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiayin, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 己未，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day normal court diet resumed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以虞允文爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事，王剛中同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Yu Yunwen was made Participating Administrator and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wang Gangzhong was Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yu and Wang were promoted in the military commission.

sentences.zh: 命淮西、湖北、荆襄帥臣措置屯田，復置榷場。

translations.literal: Military commissioners of Huaixi, Hubei, and Jingxiang were ordered to arrange military colonies; monopoly markets were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Colonies and border markets were restored on the western front.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，黃祖舜薨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Huang Zushun died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Huang Zushun died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 己巳，罷諸軍額外制領將佐。

translations.literal: On the day jisi extra commanding officers and assistants in all armies were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day extra army officers were cut.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 是春，湖南盜起，入廣東焚掠州縣，官軍討平之。

translations.literal: That spring bandits rose in Hunan, entered Guangdong, burned and plundered prefectures and counties; government troops suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Hunan bandits raided Guangdong until suppressed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，金報問使完顏仲等入見。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengzi, the Jin returning-envoy Wanyan Zhong and others entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Jin envoy Wanyan Zhong had audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳璘入見。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Wu Lin entered audience.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Wu Lin had audience.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，以璘爲太傅，封新安郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Lin was made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wu Lin became Grand Preceptor, Prince of Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔有司治皇后家廟。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen an edict ordered the relevant offices to build the empress's family temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the empress's family temple was ordered built.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔監司、帥守講究弊事以聞。

translations.literal: On the day renxu an edict ordered circuit intendants and military commissioners to investigate abuses and report.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day officials were to report abuses.

sentences.zh: 合廣南東、西路監事爲一司。

translations.literal: The supervisory offices of eastern and western Guangnan were combined into one.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan supervisory offices were merged.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔總領、帥、漕臣、諸軍都統制並兼提領措置屯田，沿邊守臣兼管屯田事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai an edict ordered directors-general, military commissioners, transport commissioners, and army commanders-in-chief all concurrently to direct military colonies; border prefects also to manage colony affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day colony duties were assigned across the border administration.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔吳璘措置馬綱、水路。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao an edict ordered Wu Lin to arrange horse quotas and water routes.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Wu Lin was to manage horses and waterways.

sentences.zh: 壬申，蠲四川州縣虛額錢。

translations.literal: On the day renshen fictitious quota money of Sichuan prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Sichuan fictitious levies were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 吳璘改判興元府。

translations.literal: Wu Lin was transferred to act as prefect of Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Lin was made acting prefect of Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔未銓試人毋得堂除。

translations.literal: On the day yihai an edict ordered that persons who had not passed the selection examination must not receive direct appointment from the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day unexamined appointees were barred from hall appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣李若川等使金賀上尊號。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Li Ruochuan and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the superior honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Li Ruochuan's embassy congratulated the Jin honorific.

sentences.zh: 增置諸路鈐轄、都監。

translations.literal: Controller and commander posts on all routes were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Route controllers and commanders were increased.

sentences.zh: 郴州盜李金等復作亂，遣兵討捕之。

translations.literal: In Chenzhou the bandit Li Jin and others again rebelled; troops were sent to pursue and capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jin rebelled again at Chenzhou and troops were sent against him.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，王剛中薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guiwei, Wang Gangzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei day, Wang Gangzhong died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔恭王府直講王淮傾邪不正，有違禮經，可與外任。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou an edict said: Direct Lecturer Wang Huai of the Palace of Prince Gong was crooked and improper and violated the ritual classics; he may be given an outside post.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Wang Huai of Prince Gong's household was dismissed for violating ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以翰林學士洪適簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Academician of the Hanlin Academy Hong Shi was made Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Hong Shi became military signatory.

sentences.zh: 戊子，步軍司統制官崔皋坐奏功冒濫，奪所遷觀察使，止進橫行三官，令本軍自效。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Cui Gao, commanding officer of the Infantry Division, was punished for inflated merit claims; the Observer he had been advanced to was stripped; he was advanced only three lateral ranks and ordered to redeem himself in his own army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Cui Gao was punished for false merit claims and ordered to redeem himself in the ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以武經郎令德爲安定郡王。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Military Classics Gentleman Ling De was made Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Ling De was made Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以淮南轉運判官姚岳言境內飛蝗自死，奪一官罷之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Yao Yue, transport vice commissioner of Huainan, reported that flying locusts in his jurisdiction had died on their own; one rank was stripped and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yao Yue was dismissed for a false locust report.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以兩淮守令勞徠安集無效，下詔戒飭之，仍以詔置守令治所。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, because prefects of the two Huai had been ineffective in comforting and settling the people, an edict admonished them and also ordered their official residences set by edict.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Huai prefects were admonished for failing to settle the people.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，蠲廣東殘破郡縣稅賦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin taxes of ravaged prefectures and counties in Guangdong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Guangdong war-torn districts were tax-exempt.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，罷湖北、京西制置司。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Hubei and Jingxi Pacification Commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Hubei-Jingxi commission was abolished.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔知州年七十以上者與宮觀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinhai, an edict ordered that prefects aged seventy or above be given palace or mountain temple sinecures.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinhai day, prefects over seventy received sinecures.

sentences.zh: 癸丑。

translations.literal: On the day guichou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day.

sentences.zh: 輔臣晚對選德殿，御坐後有大屏，記注諸道監司、郡守姓名，因令都堂視此書之。

translations.literal: Chief ministers held evening audience at Xuande Hall; behind the imperial seat was a large screen recording the names of circuit intendants and prefects of all routes; the emperor therefore ordered the Secretariat to write from this.
translations.idiomatic: At evening audience the emperor had the Secretariat copy names from a screen listing all intendants and prefects.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，借職田租二年，以裨經費。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin official-field rents were borrowed for two years to supplement expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day official-field rents were borrowed for two years.

sentences.zh: 己未，鑄當二錢。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei coins worth two were cast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day two-cash coins were minted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，蠲關外四州民今年租稅及湖南賊蹂郡縣夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day jisi taxes of the people of the four prefectures outside the pass for this year were remitted, and summer taxes of Hunan counties ravaged by bandits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day border and Hunan taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，以永豐圩田賜建康都統司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, the Yongfeng polder fields were granted to the Jiankang Command Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Yongfeng polder went to Jiankang command.

sentences.zh: 癸未，獲李金。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Li Jin was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Li Jin was captured.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔立子愭爲皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou an edict established the son Qi as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Prince Qi was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，虞允文罷。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Yu Yunwen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Yu Yunwen left office.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以洪適爲參知政事兼權知樞密院事，吏部侍郎葉顒簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Hong Shi was made Participating Administrator and Acting Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Yong was Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Hong Shi and Ye Yong were promoted to top posts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立知州軍、諸路總管鈐轄都監辭見法。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin rules for farewell audience of military prefects, route commanders-in-chief, controllers, and commanders were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day farewell-audience rules for military officials were set.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，錢端禮以避東宮親嫌，罷爲資政殿大學士、提舉萬壽觀。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Qian Duanli, because of close kinship with the Eastern Palace, was dismissed and made Grand Academician of the Hall for Observing Culture and Director of the Wanshou Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Qian Duanli left office over Eastern Palace kinship.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吏部侍郎章服以論虞允文阿附罷，謫居汀州。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Vice Minister of Personnel Zhang Fu was dismissed for criticizing Yu Yunwen's flattery and was exiled to reside at Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhang Fu was exiled to Tingzhou for attacking Yu Yunwen.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯，立廣國夫人錢氏爲皇太子妃。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yimao, Lady Qian of the State of Guang was established as consort of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Lady Qian became the crown prince's consort.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，申嚴百司官出入局之制。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the system of officials of all offices entering and leaving the bureau was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day bureau entry rules were tightened.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，升鼎州爲常德府。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Dingzhou was elevated to Changde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Dingzhou became Changde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以端明殿學士汪澈知樞密院事，洪適兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Academician of the Duanming Hall Wang Che was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Hong Shi was also Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wang Che and Hong Shi took military posts.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，置沿淮諸州都巡檢。

translations.literal: On the day yihai regional inspectors were established along the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Huai regional inspectors were set.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，遣方滋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jimao, Fang Zi and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Fang Zi's embassy congratulated the Jin new year.

sentences.zh: 戊子，增頭子錢。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi the surcharge on head-tax money was increased.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day head-tax surcharges rose.

sentences.zh: 歸正人右通直郎劉蘊古坐以軍器法式送北境，伏誅。

translations.literal: Liu Yungu, a returned subject with the office of Right Vice Director of the Palace Gate, was executed for sending military regulations to the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yungu was executed for leaking arms regulations to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，御大慶殿，冊皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day renchen the emperor presided at the Hall of Great Celebration and enfeoffed the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the crown prince was enthroned at the Hall of Great Celebration.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詣德壽宮稱謝。

translations.literal: On the day guisi he went to De'shou Palace to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the emperor thanked the retired emperor at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔侍從各舉所知宗室一二人。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei an edict ordered attendants each to recommend one or two members of the imperial clan they knew.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day attendants were to recommend imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，金遣高衎等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the Jin sent Gao Yan and others to congratulate the Festival of Congregant Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Jin congratulated the festival.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，淮北紅巾賊逾淮劫掠，立賞討捕之，已而知楚州胡明遣巡尉擊殺其首蕭榮。

translations.literal: On the day yisi red-turban bandits north of the Huai crossed the river to plunder; a reward was posted for capture; it was then learned that Hu Ming of Chuzhou had patrol officers kill their leader Xiao Rong.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Huai bandits were pursued; Xiao Rong was killed by Chuzhou patrols.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，招收兩淮流散忠義人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, scattered loyal and righteous people of the two Huai were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month scattered Huai loyalists were recruited.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day white vapor filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣龍大淵撫諭兩淮，措置屯田，督捕盜賊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Long Dayuan was dispatched to reassure the two Huai, arrange military colonies, and supervise capture of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Long Dayuan was sent to the two Huai.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以洪适爲尚書右僕射、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使，汪澈爲樞密使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuyin, Hong Shi was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Associate Director of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wang Che was Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Hong Shi and Wang Che became chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 命廣東提刑司招安李金餘黨。

translations.literal: The Guangdong judicial commission was ordered to offer amnesty to the remaining party of Li Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong was to amnesty Li Jin's remnants.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣王曮等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Wang Yan and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Wang Yan's embassy congratulated the Jin birthday.

sentences.zh: 康寅，以葉顒爲參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Ye Yong was made Participating Administrator and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Ye Yong was promoted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔侍從、臺諫、兩省舉堪監司、郡守者各一人，三衙、知閣舉材武可守邊者一人。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao an edict ordered attendants, remonstrating censors, and officials of the two inner departments each to recommend one man fit to be circuit intendant or prefect; the Three Yamen guards and Commissioners of the Bureau of Palace Gates each to recommend one man of martial talent fit to guard the border.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day officials were to recommend intendants, prefects, and border commanders.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷兩淮諸州權攝官。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi acting officials of all prefectures of the two Huai were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day acting Huai prefects were ended.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金遣烏古論忠弼等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin the Jin sent Wugulun Zhongbi and others to congratulate the new year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jin sent new-year greetings.

sentences.zh: 癸卯。

translations.literal: On the day guimao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密院文書依三省式，經中書門下畫黃書讀。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bureau of Military Affairs documents to follow the format of the Three Departments, passing through the Secretariat and Chancellery for yellow-copy drafting and reading.
translations.idiomatic: Military documents were brought under Secretariat procedure.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛酉，省六合戍兵，以所墾田給還復業之民。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on the day xinyou, garrison troops of Liuhe were reduced and the fields they had reclaimed were given to people returning to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 2 Liuhe garrisons were cut and fields returned to civilians.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命湖南監司存恤寇盜殘破郡縣。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Hunan intendants were ordered to succor counties ravaged by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hunan officials were to aid bandit-ravaged counties.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，罷盱眙屯田，振兩浙、江東饑。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingchou, the Xuyi military colony was abolished and the two Zhe and Jiangdong famines were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Xuyi colonies ended and Zhe-Jiangdong famine relief began.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸玉津園宴射，遂幸龍井。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the emperor visited Jade Ford Garden for archery feast and then visited Longjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the emperor feasted at Jade Ford and visited Longjing.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，禁京西、利州路科役保勝義士。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day yisi, corvée levies on Baosheng righteous soldiers of western Jing and Lizhou routes were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month corvée on Baosheng troops was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔戒飭刑獄官。

translations.literal: On the day renzi an edict admonished officials of penal prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day prison officials were admonished.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殿中侍御史王伯庠請裁定奏薦，詔三省、臺諫集議，具條式以聞。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Palace Attendant Censor Wang Boxiang requested fixed rules for memorial recommendation; an edict ordered the Three Departments and remonstrating censors to assemble, discuss, and report detailed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day memorial-recommendation rules were ordered drafted.

sentences.zh: 詔：「縣令非兩任，毋除監察御史；

translations.literal: An edict said: "A county magistrate who has not served two terms may not be appointed Supervising Censor;
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred unseasoned magistrates from the censorate;

sentences.zh: 非任守臣，毋除郎官。

translations.literal: one who has not served as a defending minister may not be appointed Bureau Official.
translations.idiomatic: none without prefectural service could enter the central bureaus.

sentences.zh: 著爲令。

translations.literal: This was established as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was codified.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，賜禮部進士蕭國梁以下四百九十有三人及第、出身。

translations.literal: " On the day dingmao four hundred ninety-three men from Xiao Guoliang down among the Jinshi graduates of the Ministry of Rites were granted passage of the examinations and formal inception.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day four hundred ninety-three new Jinshi graduated.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，再增諸州軍離軍添差員闕。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the quota of additional detached posts for leaving the army in all prefectures and armies was again increased.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day detached army posts increased again.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷洪适右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Hong Shi was dismissed as Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hong Shi left the right vice directorship.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以給事中、權吏部尚書魏𣏌同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Drafting Academician and Acting Minister of Personnel Wei Qi was Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Wei Qi became acting military vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，罷和糴。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou harmonized purchase was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day harmonized grain purchase ended.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，以久雨，命侍從、臺諫議刑政所宜以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wuyin, because of prolonged rain, an edict ordered attendants and remonstrating censors to discuss what was appropriate in criminal administration and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month prolonged rain led to criminal-policy review.

sentences.zh: 減大理、三衙、臨安府及浙西州縣雜犯死罪以下囚一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: Prisoners below capital crimes in the Court of Judicial Review, Three Yamen guards, Lin'an Prefecture, and prefectures and counties of western Zhe were reduced one grade; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners across the capital and western Zhe received sentence reductions.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔兩浙漕臣王炎開平江、湖、秀圍田。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen an edict ordered Huainan transport commissioner Wang Yan to open polder fields in Pingjiang, Hu, and Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Wang Yan was to open polders in the lake districts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，避殿減膳。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the emperor left the hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor reduced court and diet.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，御殿復膳。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the emperor resumed meals in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day normal court diet resumed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，汪澈罷。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Wang Che was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wang Che left office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以知荆南府李道憑恃戚里妄作，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Li Dao of Jingnan was dismissed for relying on imperial kinship and acting recklessly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Li Dao was dismissed for abusing kinship ties.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，張燾薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wushen, Zhang Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Zhang Tao died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷權借職田。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou borrowing of official fields was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day borrowing of official fields ended.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，葉顒罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Ye Yong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Ye Yong left office.

sentences.zh: 以魏𣏌爲參知政事，右諫議大夫林安宅同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，中書舍人蔣芾簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wei Qi was made Participating Administrator; Right Remonstrating Censor Lin Anzhai was Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Participating Administrator; Drafting Academician Jiang Fu was Signatory of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Qi, Lin Anzhai, and Jiang Fu were promoted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Venus crossed the sky at noon.

sentences.zh: 禁浙西修築圍田。

translations.literal: Construction of polder fields in western Zhe was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Western Zhe polder construction was banned.

sentences.zh: 罷修建康行宮。

translations.literal: Construction of the traveling palace at Jiankang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiankang traveling palace project was canceled.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命監司、守臣預備水旱。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao intendants and prefects were ordered to prepare against flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day officials were to prepare for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，罷兩浙路提舉市舶司。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiaxu, the two Zhe route maritime trade commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Zhe maritime trade office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 詔諸路監司、帥臣各察守令臧否以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered intendants and military commissioners of all routes each to investigate the good and bad conduct of prefects and report.
translations.idiomatic: All routes were to report on prefect conduct.

sentences.zh: 丙子，刑部上《乾道新編特旨斷例》。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi the Ministry of Punishments submitted the Newly Compiled Precedents of Special Edicts of the Qiandao Era.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Qiandao criminal precedents were submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔制科權罷注疏出題，守臣、監司亦許解送。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin an edict ordered that for the special examination, commentary questions be suspended and that defending ministers and intendants also be permitted to forward candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day special-examination rules were revised.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，封孫挺爲福州觀察使、榮國公，攄爲左千牛衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Sun Ting was enfeoffed as Observer of Fuzhou and Duke of the State of Rong; Shu was made Grand General of the Left Thousand Ox Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sun Ting and Shu received enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔使相毋奏補文資，七色補官人毋任子，堂吏遷朝議大夫以五員爲額。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei an edict ordered that chief ministers not memorialize appointments of civil posts, that persons appointed through the seven-color system not have sons appointed, and that hall clerks promoted to Court Gentleman for Consultation be limited to a quota of five.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day appointment abuses by ministers and clerks were restricted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，申嚴內外牒式法，裁其額。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou the law on memorial forms inside and outside was strictly enforced and the quota was cut.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day memorial-form quotas were cut.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，廢永豐圩。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu the Yongfeng polder was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Yongfeng polder was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔改官人實曆知縣一任，方許關升。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu an edict ordered that persons changing office must serve one full term as acting magistrate of a county before they might request promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day county service was required before promotion.

sentences.zh: 著爲定式。

translations.literal: This was established as a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The rule was made permanent.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，調泉州左翼軍二千人屯許浦鎮。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, two thousand men of the Left Wing Army of Quanzhou were transferred to garrison Xupu town.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Quanzhou troops garrisoned Xupu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以鎮江都統制戚方爲武當軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Qi Fang, Commander-in-Chief of Zhenjiang, was made Military Commissioner of Wudang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Qi Fang became Wudang commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，詔兩淮行鐵錢，銅錢毋過江北。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, xinwei, an edict ordered the two Huai to use iron coins and copper coins not to cross north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Huai iron-coin zone was set and copper barred north.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以武鋒軍隸步軍司。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the Martial Vanguard Army was placed under the Infantry Division.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Martial Vanguard joined the infantry.

sentences.zh: 甲戌。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day.

sentences.zh: 罷任子年三十得免試參選之令。

translations.literal: The regulation that sons at thirty could be exempted from examination and enter selection was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The age-thirty son exemption from examination was ended.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，蠲淮南放歸萬弩手差役二年。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou corvée for crossbowmen released in Huainan was remitted for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Huainan crossbowmen had two years' corvée forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔諸州守臣兼訓練禁軍。

translations.literal: On the day renwu an edict ordered prefects of all prefectures concurrently to train the forbidden armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day prefects were to train local garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 癸未，降會子、交子於鎮江、建康務場，令江、淮之人對換。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei exchange notes and exchange bills were issued at the offices of Zhenjiang and Jiankang for people of Jiang and Huai to exchange.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day notes were issued at Zhenjiang and Jiankang for Huai exchange.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，林安宅劾葉顒之子受金失實，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Lin Anzhai impeached Ye Yong's son for receiving gold falsely; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Lin Anzhai ousted Ye Yong over a false bribery charge.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔安宅筠州居住，溫州大水。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai an edict ordered Anzhai to reside at Yunzhou; Wenzhou suffered great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Lin Anzhai was sent to Yunzhou as Wenzhou flooded.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以魏杞兼同知樞密院事，蔣芾權參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Wei Qi was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Jiang Fu was Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Wei Qi and Jiang Fu were promoted.

sentences.zh: 召葉顒。

translations.literal: Ye Yong was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Yong was summoned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，少保、新興郡王吳蓋薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Junior Guardian and Prince of Xinxing Wu Gai died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Prince of Xinxing Wu Gai died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，立中興以來十三處戰功格目。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu thirteen categories of battle merit since the Restoration were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day thirteen Restoration battle-merit grades were set.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔吳璘復判興州。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei an edict ordered Wu Lin again to act as prefect of Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Wu Lin returned to Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，升宣州爲甯國府。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Xuanzhou was elevated to Ningguo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Xuanzhou became Ningguo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 罷戶部諸路歲糴一年。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue's annual grain purchase on all routes was abolished for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Annual grain purchase was suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，知上元縣李允升犯髒貸死，杖脊刺面，配惠州牢城，籍其貲。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiachen, Li Yunsheng, magistrate of Shangyuan, was guilty of corrupt bribes warranting death; he was beaten with the rod on the back, tattooed on the face, and exiled to Huizhou prison city; his property was registered.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Yunsheng of Shangyuan was executed by exile for corruption.

sentences.zh: 丙午，建康守臣王佐坐縱允升去官，奪三官勒停、建昌軍居住。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Wang Zuo, defending official of Jiankang, was punished for allowing Yunsheng to escape office; three ranks were stripped, he was struck from the rolls and suspended, and made to reside at Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wang Zuo was punished for letting the corrupt magistrate escape.

sentences.zh: 余失按官吏及薦舉官奪官有差。

translations.literal: The remaining negligent officials and recommending officials had their offices stripped in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Other negligent and recommending officials were punished in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣官按視溫州水災，振貧民，決系囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai officials were dispatched to inspect the flood disaster in Wenzhou, relieve poor people, and decide cases of detained prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Wenzhou flood victims were aided and prisoners reviewed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔改造大曆。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict ordered reform of the great calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day calendar reform was ordered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，追封子恪爲邵王，諡曰悼肅。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the son Ke was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shao; his posthumous title was Daosu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the late Prince Ke was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔監司各舉部內知縣、縣令二三人，守臣各舉屬縣一二人。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi an edict ordered each intendant to recommend two or three magistrates and magistrates within his jurisdiction; each defending minister to recommend one or two subordinate counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day intendants and ministers were to recommend local officials.

sentences.zh: 己巳，魏𣏌等上神宗、哲宗、徽宗三朝《帝紀》、《太上皇聖政》。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Wei Qi and others presented the Imperial Annals of Shenzong, Zhezong, and Huizong and the Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Wei Qi presented the three dynastic annals and retired emperor's governance.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔舉將帥，置章奏簿。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered recommendation of generals and establishment of a memorial register.
translations.idiomatic: That month generals were to be recommended and a register kept.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，上《太上皇聖政》于德壽宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guiyou, the Sagely Governance of the Retired Emperor was presented at De'shou Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the retired emperor's Sagely Governance was presented at De'shou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣薛良朋等使金賀正旦。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Xue Liangpeng and others were dispatched as envoys to the Jin to congratulate the new year.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xue Liangpeng's embassy congratulated the Jin new year.

sentences.zh: 己卯，減饒州歲貢金三之一，蠲諸路灑坊逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Raozhou's annual gold tribute was reduced by one third, and overdue levies on wine shops on all routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Raozhou gold tribute was cut and wine-shop arrears forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知峽州呂令問坐縱髒吏知夷陵縣韓贄胄去官，奪二官、鄂州居住。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Lü Lingwen, prefect of Xiazhou, was punished for allowing the corrupt official Han Zangzhou, magistrate of Yiling, to leave office; two ranks were stripped and he was made to reside at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Lü Lingwen of Xiazhou was demoted to Ezhou for shielding a corrupt magistrate.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day hail fell.

sentences.zh: 金遣魏子平等來賀會慶節。

translations.literal: The Jin sent Wei Ziping and others to congratulate the Festival of Congregant Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin sent Wei Ziping to congratulate the festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，楊存中薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingwu, Yang Cunzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yang Cunzhong died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，盡出內藏及南庫銀以易會子，官司並以錢銀支遣，民間從便。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou all silver from the inner storehouse and southern vault was released to exchange for notes; government offices were all to disburse in cash and silver as convenient for the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day inner silver was used to back notes and offices paid in coin.

sentences.zh: 兩淮總領所許自造會子。

translations.literal: The two Huai directorates-general were permitted to issue notes on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The two Huai treasuries could issue notes locally.

sentences.zh: 鬻諸路營田。

translations.literal: Military colonies on all routes were sold off.
translations.idiomatic: Route military colonies were sold.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔修祥曦殿記注。

translations.literal: On the day renzi an edict ordered compilation of the record of the Xiangxi Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Xiangxi Hall record was ordered compiled.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，密詔四川制置使汪應辰：如吳璘不起，收其宣撫使牌印，權行主管職事。

translations.literal: On the day yimao a secret edict to Sichuan Commissioner Wang Yingchen said: if Wu Lin does not take office, seize his Pacification Commissioner seals and temporarily exercise supervisory duties.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Wang Yingchen was secretly ordered to take Wu Lin's seals if he refused office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi a great review of troops was held.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day a grand troop review was held.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，築郢州城。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the walls of Yingzhou were built.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Yingzhou's walls were built.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔汰冗兵。

translations.literal: That month an edict ordered elimination of redundant soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: That month redundant troops were cut.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午朔，白氣亙天。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengwu, the first day of the month, white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month white vapor filled the sky on the new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔三省、侍從、台諫、兩淮漕臣、郡守，條具兩淮鐵錢、交子利害以聞。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou an edict ordered the Three Departments, attendants, remonstrating censors, two Huai transport commissioners, and prefects to list the harms and benefits of Huai iron coins and exchange notes and report.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day officials were to report on Huai currency policy.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣梁克家等賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Liang Kejia and others were dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Liang Kejia's embassy congratulated the Jin birthday.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以資政殿學士葉顒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Academician of the Zizheng Hall Ye Yong was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Ye Yong became military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔免進呈《欽宗日曆》，送國史院修纂實錄。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi an edict waived presentation of the Calendar of Emperor Qinzong and sent it to the Historiography Institute to compile the Veritable Record.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Qinzong's calendar went to the Historiography Institute for the Veritable Record.

sentences.zh: 壬午，追封楊存中爲和王。

translations.literal: On the day renwu Yang Cunzhong was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of He.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Yang Cunzhong was posthumously made Prince of He.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以葉顒爲尚書左僕射，魏杞右僕射，並同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Ye Yong was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Wei Qi was Right Vice Director; both were Associate Directors of the Secretariat and Chancellery and Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Ye Yong and Wei Qi became chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 蔣芾參知政事，吏部尚書陳俊卿同知樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: Jiang Fu was Participating Administrator; Minister of Personnel Chen Junqing was Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Acting Participating Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Fu and Chen Junqing received top posts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔宰相領兼制國用使，參知政事同知國用事。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin an edict ordered chief ministers to head concurrently the Office for Regulating State Revenue; participating administrators to know state revenue affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day ministers took charge of state revenue.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔監司、守臣舉廉吏。

translations.literal: On the day guisi an edict ordered intendants and prefects to recommend incorrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day incorrupt officials were to be recommended.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金遣烏古論元忠等來賀明年正旦。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the Jin sent Wugulun Yuanzhong and others to congratulate the new year of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Jin sent new-year greetings.

sentences.zh: 以江東兵馬鈐轄王抃爲帶禦器械。

translations.literal: Wang Bian, Controller of Jiangdong military forces, was given charge of imperial arms.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bian received charge of imperial arms.

sentences.zh: 是歲，裁定內外軍額。

translations.literal: That year the quotas of armies inside and outside were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That year inner and outer army quotas were fixed.
